classPractice.question: After hours of investigation, the committee at last ____ (establish) the true cause of the accident.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义"查明"；由 at last 及语境判断用一般过去时

classPractice.question: 选词填空（establish / found）：Through years of hard work, she ____ herself as one of the finest surgeons in the city.
classPractice.note: establish oneself as 确立地位，可搭配抽象宾语；found 仅指"创立机构/城市"，不能搭 oneself

original_sentence: With all sorts of communication software, physical distance no longer gets in the way.
readingExamples: With all sorts of communication software, physical distance no longer gets in the way.
definitionEn:
(1) n. the programs and other operating information used by a computer, as opposed to the physical parts of the machine (hardware)
(2) n. a particular set of such programs designed to perform a specific task

posExamples.sentence: Hunched over the flickering screen long past midnight, the boy finally saw the software he had built with his own hands spring to life, and tears of pure joy blurred the lines of code before him. （读后续写·少年·梦想成真）
I am writing to recommend a piece of learning software that has greatly improved my English, in the hope that our whole class might benefit from it too. （应用文·推荐信）
However clever a piece of software may become, it remains a tool in human hands; whether it serves us or enslaves us depends entirely on the wisdom with which we use it. （议论文·科技与人性）

With a simple translation software on her phone, the elderly traveller could at last converse with strangers in a foreign land, and the world suddenly felt a great deal smaller and kinder. （读后续写·科技·温情）

wordForms.other: hardware（n. 硬件，反义）；freeware（n. 免费软件）

collocations.translation: 通讯软件（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: With all sorts of communication software, physical distance no longer gets in the way. 有了各种通讯软件，物理距离不再是障碍。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一款/一件软件（software 不可数，用 a piece of 计量）
collocations.example: I am writing to recommend a piece of learning software. 我写信是想推荐一款学习软件。
He downloaded the free software, and within minutes his old laptop was humming along like new. 他下载了免费软件，几分钟后旧笔记本就像新的一样运转起来。
She reminded her grandfather to update the software regularly so that hackers could not slip through. （应用文·提醒）
The clinic uses special software to keep track of every patient's records safely. （说明·应用）
A single software application now handles what once required a whole office of clerks. （议论文·效率变革）
Educational software has opened the door to quality lessons for children in the remotest villages. （议论文·教育公平）

collocations.translation: 软件开发者 / 工程师
collocations.example: From a curious boy tinkering with code, he grew into a software engineer whose work touched millions of lives. （读后续写·成长）
Good anti-virus software is the first line of defence against the countless threats lurking online. （说明·网络安全）

synonyms.example: She wrote a small program to sort the thousands of files in seconds. （说明·计算机）
synonyms.usage: 指一段具体的、可执行的指令代码，是可数的单个"程序"；software 是不可数集合名词，泛指所有程序及运行信息的总称

synonyms.example: The new app lets users pay their bills with a single tap. （说明·移动应用）
synonyms.usage: 特指为完成某项具体任务而设计的应用程序，日常多用缩写 app；software 涵盖面更广，包括系统软件与应用软件

advancedExpressions.expression: software 为不可数名词，无复数、不加 a；计量用 a piece of software / two pieces of software
advancedExpressions.example: 对比：a program（可数）↔ software（不可数）；正确说 much software / a lot of software，误写 a software / softwares。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·合成词 -ware 家族
advancedExpressions.expression: soft + ware = software 软件；对应 hardware 硬件（反义），另有 freeware 免费软件、firmware 固件
advancedExpressions.example: software（程序）与 hardware（机器实体）相对；-ware 表"制品/器件"类事物。

advancedExpressions.expression: with nothing but a simple software, ... could suddenly ...
advancedExpressions.example: With nothing but a simple software on his aging phone, Grandpa could suddenly see his grandchildren's faces light up across a thousand miles. （用"科技之小"反衬"情感之大"，续写温情场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would strongly recommend ... software, which ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would strongly recommend this vocabulary software, which not only makes learning enjoyable but also tracks your progress day by day. （推荐信"推荐+理由"句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: software is ultimately but a tool; ... rests with us
advancedExpressions.example: Software is ultimately but a tool; whether it enriches our minds or dulls them rests entirely with the choices we make. （"but a tool"降调 + rests with us 归因于人，凸显主体性）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He made a piece of software and felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the software he had toiled over for months finally ran without a single error, a wave of triumph swept through him, and he realised that every sleepless night had, after all, been worth it. （读后续写·奋斗·成就感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: When 时间从句铺垫 + toiled over 替换 made 显艰辛 + a wave of triumph swept through him 隐喻情感 + realise that...every...had been worth it 回望升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: This software can help students learn better.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Far more than a mere convenience, well-designed learning software can rekindle a student's curiosity, turning the tedious task of memorising into a journey of discovery. （议论文·教育科技）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Far more than... 前置递进 + rekindle 高级动词 + turning...into... 现在分词表结果 + "tedious task / journey of discovery"对比升华

classPractice.question: 有了各种通讯软件，物理距离不再是障碍。With all sorts of communication ____, physical distance no longer gets in the way.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；software 不可数，all sorts of 后仍用单数原形，无复数 softwares

classPractice.question: I am writing to recommend a ____ of learning software that has greatly improved my English.
classPractice.note: software 不可数，计量单个软件用 a piece of software

classPractice.question: 选词填空（software / hardware）：However clever a piece of ____ may become, it still needs a physical machine—the ____—to run on.
classPractice.note: software 软件（程序）与 hardware 硬件（机器实体）为反义对照

translation: adj. 立即的，立刻的；方便的 | n. 瞬间，片刻；某一时刻
original_sentence: An instant message, a group chat, a video call, a comment on an update—there are endless ways to share our views or let someone know we care about them.
readingExamples: An instant message, a group chat, a video call, a comment on an update—there are endless ways to share our views or let someone know we care about them.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. happening or produced immediately; without any delay
(2) adj. (of food or drink) that can be prepared quickly and easily, usually by adding hot water
(3) n. a very short period of time; a moment
(4) n. a particular point in time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 瞬间，片刻（the instant = the moment，作连词引导时间状语从句：一……就……）
uncommonMeanings.example: The instant she opened the door, a gust of cold wind rushed in, and with it, the news that would change her life forever. （读后续写·转折·命运时刻）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （食品）速食的，方便的
uncommonMeanings.example: All he could afford that winter was a bowl of instant noodles, yet shared with a friend under the dim lamp, it tasted better than any feast. （读后续写·清贫·温情）

posExamples.sentence: For one breathless instant the whole gymnasium fell silent; then, as the ball dropped cleanly through the hoop, the crowd erupted into a roar that seemed to shake the very walls. （读后续写·比赛·高潮定格）
I am writing to thank you for the instant help you offered when I was lost in the crowded station, a kindness I shall never forget. （应用文·感谢信）
In an age of instant gratification, we must teach the young that the sweetest rewards are often those for which we have patiently waited. （议论文·延迟满足）

The instant the letter of admission slipped from the envelope, her mother's tired eyes filled with tears, and years of sacrifice suddenly felt, in that single moment, entirely worthwhile. （读后续写·亲情·圆梦时刻）

idioms.translation: 一……就…… （引导时间状语从句）
idioms.example: The instant he heard the cry for help, he plunged into the icy river without a second's hesitation. （读后续写·勇敢·危急关头）
In an instant, the calm afternoon was shattered as thunder rolled across the darkening sky. （读后续写·环境突变）
The moment the alarm rang, the firefighters were on their feet on the instant, racing toward the truck. （读后续写·应急）

collocations.translation: 即时消息（adj. 即时的 = immediate）【课件】
collocations.example: An instant message, a group chat, video call, a comment on an update ... 一条即时消息、一次群聊、一通视频、一句对动态的评论……（课件·课文原句）

collocations.translation: 一举成功，立即走红【课件】
collocations.example: The show was an instant success. 这个节目一炮而红。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 方便面 / 速溶咖啡（adj. 速食的）【课件】
collocations.example: instant noodles 方便面 / instant coffee 速溶咖啡（课件·义项②速食）

collocations.phrase: in an instant / in a moment
collocations.translation: 瞬间，一刹那（n. instant = moment）【课件】
collocations.example: When the rain started, the crowd vanished in an instant. 雨一下起来，人群转眼就散了。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 一……就……（instant 作连词引导时间状语从句）【课件】
collocations.example: I recognized her the instant I saw her. 我一眼就认出她了。（课件例句）
She replied instantly, unwilling to keep him waiting. 她立刻回复，不想让他久等。（课件·adv. instantly）
All he could afford that winter was a bowl of instant noodles. 那个冬天他只吃得起一碗方便面。

collocations.translation: 一……就……（引导时间状语从句）
collocations.example: The instant she opened the door, a gust of cold wind rushed in. 她一开门，一阵冷风就灌了进来。
In an instant, the calm afternoon was shattered as thunder rolled across the sky. 转眼间，平静的午后被滚过天空的雷声打破。
The little café's homemade bread was an instant success, and queues soon stretched down the street. （记叙·励志）
She sent an instant reply, unwilling to let her worried mother wait a single minute longer. （读后续写·亲情）
The Internet gives students instant access to a world of knowledge once locked away in distant libraries. （议论文·科技与教育）
For an instant she hesitated at the threshold, then squared her shoulders and stepped bravely inside. （读后续写·心理·抉择）
Not for an instant did he doubt that his friend would come, and sure enough, footsteps soon echoed at the door. （读后续写·信任·倒装）
The sight of the rescue helicopter brought instant relief to the stranded hikers. （读后续写·脱险）

synonyms.example: The situation called for immediate action, and no one dared to hesitate. （议论文/记叙·紧迫）
synonyms.usage: 强调"毫无拖延地紧接着发生"，多修饰 action/response/effect；instant 更强调"即刻实现、无需等待"，且能修饰食品（方便的）

synonyms.example: For a fleeting moment their eyes met, and everything else seemed to fade away. （读后续写·情感）
synonyms.usage: 作名词时与 instant（瞬间义）近义，moment 更常用、更中性；instant 语气更短促、更强调"一刹那"的瞬息感

synonyms.example: We are grateful for your prompt response to our request. （应用文·感谢/正式）
synonyms.usage: 多指"及时、不拖延地"作出回应，常用于正式书信；instant 强调"即时、零延迟"，程度上比 prompt 更快

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·instant 一词多义搭配
advancedExpressions.expression: an instant message（adj. 即时的）/ instant noodles（adj. 速食的）/ in an instant（n. 瞬间）/ the instant that...（n.→连词 一……就）
advancedExpressions.example: 同一词 instant 兼作形容词（即时的/速食的）与名词（瞬间），要按位置判义（词块记忆卡）。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the instant 作连词
advancedExpressions.expression: the instant (that) = the moment / as soon as，引导时间状语从句，主将从现
advancedExpressions.example: The instant he heard the cry, he plunged into the river. 他一听到呼救就跳进了河里。可与 the moment / immediately 互换。

advancedExpressions.expression: instant (adj./n.) → instantly / instantaneously (adv. 立即地) → instantaneous (adj. 瞬间的)
advancedExpressions.example: reply instantly 立即回复；an instantaneous reaction 瞬间的反应。

advancedExpressions.expression: for one fleeting/breathless instant, time seemed to stand still
advancedExpressions.example: For one breathless instant, time seemed to stand still — and then the whole world burst back into motion and sound. （用"时间静止"放慢镜头，续写高潮的经典技法）

advancedExpressions.expression: your instant help meant more to me than words can express
advancedExpressions.example: Your instant help in that moment of panic meant more to me than words can ever express. （感谢信升华句，emphasise 情感分量）

advancedExpressions.expression: in a culture of instant ..., we risk losing the value of ...
advancedExpressions.example: In a culture of instant gratification, we risk losing the quiet virtue of patience — the very quality on which every great achievement is built. （由现象引出对本质的反思）

sentenceUpgrade.original: As soon as she saw him, she started to cry.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The instant she caught sight of his familiar figure at the gate, the strength that had held her upright for so long crumbled at last, and tears she had fought back for months came pouring down her cheeks. （读后续写·重逢·情感决堤）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: The instant 引导时间从句替换 as soon as + "the strength...crumbled"隐喻坚强崩塌 + tears...came pouring down 画面化 + "had fought back for months"补出前情，情感更厚

sentenceUpgrade.original: People today want everything at once.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: We live in an age that worships the instant — instant news, instant fame, instant reward — yet in our restless craving for speed, we may be forgetting how to wait, and, with it, how to truly value what we win. （议论文·即时文化批判）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: worships the instant 拟人化批判 + 破折号三重排比 instant news/fame/reward + yet 转折 + "forgetting how to wait...how to value"平行升华，收束论点

classPractice.question: 一条即时消息、一次群聊、一通视频、一句对动态的评论……。An ____ message, a group chat, a video call, a comment on an update—there are endless ways to share our views.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；an instant message 即时消息，此处 instant 作形容词"即时的"

classPractice.question: The ____ she caught sight of his figure at the gate, tears came pouring down her cheeks.
classPractice.note: the instant (that) = as soon as 一……就……，引导时间状语从句

classPractice.question: 选词填空（instant / immediate）：All he could afford that winter was a bowl of ____ noodles.
classPractice.note: "方便面"固定为 instant noodles；immediate 无"速食"义，只表"立即的"

translation: n. 议论，评论；批评，指责 | vi. & vt. 表达意见
original_sentence: An instant message, a group chat, a video call, a comment on an update—there are endless ways to share our views or let someone know we care about them.
readingExamples: An instant message, a group chat, a video call, a comment on an update—there are endless ways to share our views or let someone know we care about them.
definitionEn:
(1) n. an opinion that you express about someone or something, usually in speech or writing
(2) n. a written note that explains or criticises something, such as a piece of work or an online post
(3) v. to express an opinion about someone or something, especially in a public or spoken way
(4) n. something that reveals a wider truth about a situation (a commentary on)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 反映某种社会现象的东西;间接的评判
uncommonMeanings.example: That so many teenagers scroll through their phones at the dinner table is, in itself, a sad comment on how technology has quietly reshaped family life. （议论文·科技与生活·借现象作评判）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （无须多言的）明证;不言自明的说明
uncommonMeanings.example: Her trembling hands and downcast eyes were comment enough on the ordeal she had just endured, and nobody dared to press her for words. （读后续写·心理刻画·无声胜有声）

posExamples.sentence: Just as I posted the photo of our stray puppy, a stranger's kind comment lit up my screen: 'What a lucky little soul to have found you.' In that instant, my earlier loneliness melted away. （读后续写·网络善意·情感转折）

I would like to comment on the recent proposal to shorten our lunch break, for I firmly believe such a change would leave students too rushed to eat properly and recharge for afternoon lessons. （应用文·建议信·表态开头）
Before rushing to comment on a stranger's post, one ought to pause and ask whether the words about to be typed would build someone up or tear them down. （议论文·网络文明·论证）
The teacher's encouraging comments in the margin of my essay, written in warm red ink, gave me the courage to keep writing when I had almost given up. （读后续写·师生·细节描写）

idioms.example: When reporters pressed the shy young inventor about his failures, he simply smiled and said, 'No comment,' letting his groundbreaking device speak for itself. （读后续写·人物·沉稳）

collocations.translation: 一句对（社交）动态的评论（n. 评论，un.）【课件】
collocations.example: a comment on an update 对更新（动态）的评论（课件·课文词块）

collocations.translation: 对……提出意见／作出评论【课件】
collocations.example: She made helpful comments on my work. 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。（课件例句）

collocations.phrase: there was a lot of comment about sth
collocations.translation: 对……有很多议论／指责（comment 作不可数）【课件】
collocations.example: There was a lot of comment about his behaviour. 对他的行为举止有很多的议论／指责。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 无可奉告（常用于回答记者提问）【课件】
collocations.example: 'No comment,' he said, and walked past the reporters without another word. “无可奉告，”他说完便一言不发地从记者身旁走过。（课件·no comment）

collocations.translation: 对……作出评论（vi. & vt. 表达意见）【课件】
collocations.example: I don't feel I can comment on their decision. 我觉得我无法对他们的决定作出评论。（课件例句）
A spokesperson commented that levels of carbon dioxide were very high. 一位发言人评论说二氧化碳含量非常高。（课件例句）

collocations.translation: 一句对（社交）动态的评论（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: An instant message, a group chat, a video call, a comment on an update—there are endless ways to share our views. 一条即时消息、一次群聊、一通视频、一句对动态的评论——分享观点的方式无穷无尽。（课文原句）
She made a thoughtful comment about the film's ending. 她就影片结局作了一番耐人寻味的评论。
In her letter, she thoughtfully commented on every suggestion I had raised. 在信中，她认真地就我提的每条建议作了评论。
When reporters pressed him, he simply smiled and said, 'No comment.' 记者追问时，他只是笑着说"无可奉告"。
He rarely makes a comment in class, yet whenever he does, his insight leaves the whole room in thoughtful silence. （读后续写·内向少年）
Feel free to leave a comment under our club's post if you have creative ideas for the coming charity fair. （应用文·通知/倡议）
Instead of crumbling under a flood of negative comments, the young singer used each one as fuel to refine her craft. （读后续写·逆境成长）
The exhibition drew favourable comments from visitors of every age, proving that art truly knows no boundaries. （应用文·活动报道）
The headmaster declined to comment until a full investigation into the incident had been carried out. （议论文/新闻·态度审慎）
'That's a fair comment,' the coach admitted, nodding at the boy who had dared to point out the team's weakness. （读后续写·对话）
We warmly invite comments from all members so that next term's reading plan can better suit everyone's needs. （应用文·倡议书）

synonyms.example: A single careless remark, tossed off in a moment of anger, can wound a friendship that took years to build. （议论文·言语的分量）
synonyms.usage: remark 多指随口说出的简短评论,常口语化;comment 更正式,可用于书面评价或对某事的正式表态

synonyms.example: In my opinion, spending a little time offline each day is essential for a healthy, balanced life. （应用文·观点表达）
synonyms.usage: opinion 强调个人主观看法本身;comment 强调把看法'说/写出来'这一表达行为

synonyms.example: The teacher's detailed feedback on my draft turned a mediocre essay into one I was proud of. （应用文·学习感悟）
synonyms.usage: feedback 指针对表现或作品给出的、旨在改进的反馈,不可数;comment 是可数的一条条评论

advancedExpressions.expression: make/leave a comment on sth / comment on sth（v.）/ no comment / invite comments
advancedExpressions.example: make a comment on an update 就动态评论；comment on the news 评论新闻；No comment. 无可奉告（词块记忆卡）

advancedExpressions.expression: comment (n./v.) → commentary (n. 实况解说/评述) → commentator (n. 评论员/解说员)
advancedExpressions.example: a running commentary 现场解说；a football commentator 足球解说员；名词 comment 可数，commentary 多指连续评述。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·名词 vs 动词的搭配差异
advancedExpressions.expression: 名词：make/leave a comment on sth；动词：comment on sth（不及物+on）
advancedExpressions.example: 对比 make a comment on the essay（名词短语）与 comment on the essay（动词短语），介词都用 on。

advancedExpressions.expression: a passing comment that would change everything
advancedExpressions.example: What began as a passing comment from a stranger — 'You have a gift, you know' — took root in her heart and, years later, blossomed into the courage to chase her dream. （伏笔照应，由一句评论牵起全篇）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would like to comment that ..., and therefore suggest that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would like to comment that our current recycling scheme, though well-intentioned, is poorly publicised, and therefore suggest that eye-catching posters be put up in every corridor. （先评后议，建议信结构清晰）

advancedExpressions.expression: it is not without significance that ... — a telling comment on ...
advancedExpressions.example: It is not without significance that many people now trust an anonymous online comment over a face-to-face conversation — a telling comment on the fragile state of real human connection.

sentenceUpgrade.original: Someone left a nice comment on my post and I felt happy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Just as loneliness was tightening its grip on me, a stranger's gentle comment slipped into the silence of my screen — 'You are braver than you think' — and, like sunlight breaking through storm clouds, it warmed a corner of my heart I had thought long since frozen. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境/心理铺垫(loneliness tightening its grip) + 破折号插入直接引语 + like...比喻 + 情感反转收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should not make bad comments online.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Before we let our fingers fly across the keyboard, we would do well to remember that behind every screen sits a real person, and that a single thoughtless comment can leave a wound no apology can fully heal. （议论文·网络文明）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: we would do well to remember 委婉劝诫句式 + behind every screen 具象化 + a wound no apology can heal 隐喻收尾

classPractice.question: 她对我的工作提出了有益的意见。She ____ helpful ____ ____ my work.
classPractice.note: 课件例句；make comments on sth=对……提出意见，名词后接介词 on。

classPractice.type: 单句填空（课件·v. comment that）
classPractice.question: A spokesperson ____ that levels of carbon dioxide were very high.
classPractice.note: 课件例句；comment that + 从句=评论说……，此处一般过去时 commented。

classPractice.question: 一条即时消息、一次群聊、一通视频、一句对动态的评论……。An instant message, a group chat, a video call, a ____ on an update—there are endless ways to share our views.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；a comment on an update 一句对动态的评论，名词后接 on 表评论对象

classPractice.question: Before rushing to ____ (comment) on a stranger's post, one ought to pause and think.
classPractice.note: comment on sth 评论某事（不及物动词+on）；rush to do 后接动词原形

classPractice.question: When reporters pressed the shy inventor about his failures, he simply smiled and said, '____ ____,' letting his device speak for itself.
classPractice.note: no comment 无可奉告，礼貌而坚定地拒绝回应

translation: 知道，意识到；察觉到，发觉；有…意识的
original_sentence: As with any great invention, we must be aware of these problems and be careful to use the Internet properly and responsibly.
readingExamples: As with any great invention, we must be aware of these problems and be careful to use the Internet properly and responsibly.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. knowing that something exists, or having knowledge or experience of a particular thing
(2) adj. noticing that something is happening or is the case; conscious of
(3) adj. concerned about and well informed regarding a particular subject or issue (often in compounds, e.g. health-aware)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 见多识广的;有见识的、敏感的（作后置或独立形容词，指对世事、社会问题有认识）
uncommonMeanings.example: Travelling alone across three continents had turned the once-sheltered boy into a remarkably aware young man, alert to injustices his classmates never even noticed. （读后续写·人物蜕变·眼界打开）

posExamples.sentence: The moment I stepped into the silent ward, I became acutely aware of every beeping monitor and every shallow breath, and my careless chatter died in my throat. （读后续写·环境感知·氛围转变）
As with any powerful tool, we must be fully aware of the risks of the Internet and teach ourselves to use it wisely and responsibly. （应用文·倡议书·呼吁）
Only when we are truly aware of the consequences of our online behaviour can we begin to build a healthier, kinder digital community. （议论文·网络文明·观点）
Little did the volunteers know, as they packed the last box of supplies, that the villagers were painfully aware of just how far these strangers had travelled to help them. （读后续写·视角转换·感恩）

wordForms.adjective: aware (意识到的) / unaware (未意识到的,反义) / self-aware (有自我认知的)
wordForms.other: 构词法:un-(否定前缀)+aware→unaware 未察觉的;self-(自我)+aware→self-aware 有自知之明的。贴士:aware 是表语形容词,通常只作表语(be/become/make sb aware),一般不直接放名词前作定语;要修饰名词多用 informed/conscious。搭配固定:aware OF sth 或 aware THAT 从句,不说 aware to。

collocations.example: As with any great invention, we must be aware of these problems and be careful to use the Internet properly and responsibly. （课件·Reading 原句）
I was aware that something went wrong. 我意识到出了问题。（课件·Reading slide 35）

collocations.phrase: as you are aware / as far as I'm aware
collocations.translation: 【课件】正如你所知道的 / 据我所知
collocations.example: As you are aware, sharing personal information carelessly online can lead to serious trouble. （课件·Reading slide 35）
As with any great invention, the Internet brings both benefits and dangers. （课件·Reading slide 35）
They suddenly became aware of people looking at them. 他们突然意识到有人在看他们。（课件·Reading slide 36）

collocations.translation: 【课件】有环保意识的（aware 与副词连用，表示'有……意识的'）
collocations.example: Young people are very environmentally aware. 年轻人很有环保意识。（课件·Reading slide 36）

collocations.translation: 【课件】未意识到的（aware 的反义词）
collocations.example: Many users remain completely unaware of how much of their private data is being collected. （课件·Reading slide 36）

collocations.phrase: raise / heighten one's awareness of sth
collocations.example: These questions aim to raise students' awareness of the grammatical rules. 这些问题旨在提高学生对语法规则的认识。（课件·Reading slide 36-37）
There is a growing awareness of the dangers hidden behind a careless click. 人们逐渐认识到一次不慎的点击背后隐藏的危险。（课件·Reading slide 37）

collocations.translation: 意识到这些问题（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: As with any great invention, we must be aware of these problems and be careful to use the Internet properly and responsibly. （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 意识到、清楚（后接宾语从句）
collocations.example: Every user must be aware that one careless click can leak private data. 每个用户都应清楚一次不慎的点击就可能泄露隐私。
Few of us are fully aware of how much precious time slips away as we scroll aimlessly through our phones. （议论文·时间管理）
I am well aware that these suggestions may not be easy to carry out, yet I sincerely believe they are worth a try. （应用文·建议信·谦辞）
It was only after his grandmother fell ill that he became painfully aware of how little time he had spent with her. （读后续写·懊悔觉醒）
Standing before the vast, silent mountains, she was keenly aware of her own smallness in the face of nature. （读后续写·哲思）
The organisers were well aware that a successful charity sale depends on the enthusiasm of every single helper. （应用文·活动方案）
This campaign aims to make every student aware of the hidden dangers of sharing personal information online. （应用文·倡议）
By organising a mock trial of 'cyber-bullying', the club hoped to raise awareness of a problem too often swept under the carpet. （应用文·活动报道）
Today's environmentally aware youngsters carry reusable bottles and refuse plastic bags without a second thought. （议论文·青年责任）

synonyms.example: She was suddenly conscious of the fact that everyone in the room was waiting for her answer. （读后续写·紧张时刻）
synonyms.usage: conscious 侧重当下的、直接的知觉,也可指'神志清醒';aware 更强调因了解、留意而'知道',范围更广

synonyms.example: Please be mindful of others when you speak online, for words travel farther and cut deeper than we imagine. （应用文·倡议）
synonyms.usage: mindful 常含'主动留心、有意关照'的态度色彩,后接 of;aware 更中性,只表'知道'

synonyms.example: A good driver stays alert to every movement at the roadside, ready to react in a split second. （读后续写·紧张场景）
synonyms.usage: alert 强调警觉、随时准备反应;aware 只强调认知层面的'知道',不含'戒备'之意

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·only+状语置句首的部分倒装(Only in this way can...)
advancedExpressions.expression: "only + 副词/介词短语/状语从句"置于句首时，主句用部分倒装（把助动词或情态动词提到主语之前）：Only in this way can... / Only when... / Only then...
advancedExpressions.example: Only in this way can the Internet be a place of discovery, wonder and inspiration for everyone. （课件·Reading slide 38 原句）Only when she came home did her mother learn the news. / Only then did he understand the plot of the film. （课件·slide 39）

advancedExpressions.expression: be aware of / that; become aware of; make sb aware of; raise awareness of
advancedExpressions.example: We must be aware of these problems, become aware of our own habits, and work together to raise awareness of online safety. 四个高频短语一网打尽。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示"意识到、清楚"
advancedExpressions.expression: be aware of / be conscious of / be mindful of / be alert to / realize that
advancedExpressions.example: 只表"意识到"这一功能时,五者常可替换:be aware of the risks = be conscious of the risks = realize the risks。

advancedExpressions.expression: aware + of + n./doing;aware + that 从句;不接不定式
advancedExpressions.example: I am aware of the danger. / I am aware that it is dangerous. 记住:aware 后跟 of 短语或 that 从句,不能说 aware to do。

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, sb. became aware of ...
advancedExpressions.example: For the first time in her life, she became aware that courage was not the absence of fear but the quiet decision to move forward in spite of it. （抽象觉悟句,续写点题升华）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cannot afford to be unaware of ...; it is high time we ...
advancedExpressions.example: We cannot afford to be unaware of the toll that endless screen time takes on our eyes and minds; it is high time we set clear limits for ourselves. （否定式警醒 + it is high time 呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: only when we are aware of ... can we truly ...
advancedExpressions.example: Only when we are aware of both the promise and the perils of technology can we truly become its masters rather than its slaves.

sentenceUpgrade.original: She suddenly knew that everyone was looking at her.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A prickling sensation crept up her neck, and all at once she became acutely aware of the ring of curious eyes fixed upon her, each gaze pressing down like a physical weight. （读后续写·心理描写+通感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 生理反应先行(prickling sensation) + become acutely aware of 觉察升级 + 明喻(like a physical weight)

sentenceUpgrade.original: People should know the dangers of the Internet.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is imperative that every user of the Internet be made keenly aware of its hidden dangers, for only an informed mind can navigate the digital world without falling prey to its traps. （议论文·科技利弊）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is imperative that + 虚拟语气(be made) + keenly aware 程度副词 + for only... 因果论证 + fall prey to 高级搭配

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 人们日益担心空气质量，部分是因为他们对这个问题的意识增强了。The ____ ____ ____ air quality is ____ due to ____ ____ ____ the issue.
classPractice.answer: growing concern about; partly; increased awareness of
classPractice.note: 课件 Reading slide 37 原题;growing concern about 对……日益担心;partly due to 部分归因于;increased awareness of 对……增强的意识。完整句:The growing concern about air quality is partly due to increased awareness of the issue.

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件）
classPractice.question: 这些问题旨在提高学生对语法规则的认识。These questions ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ the grammatical rules.
classPractice.answer: aim to raise students' awareness of
classPractice.note: 课件 Reading slide 37 原题;aim to do 旨在;raise one's awareness of 提高对……的意识

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件·only 倒装）
classPractice.question: Only after talking to two students ____ ____ (我才发现) that having strong motivation is one of the biggest factors in reaching goals.
classPractice.note: 课件 Reading slide 40 原题;Only + 状语置句首，主句部分倒装，把助动词 did 提到主语 I 之前

classPractice.type: 语境应用·完成句子（课件·only 倒装）
classPractice.question: Only when we stick to what we have decided to do ____ ____ ____ ____ (我们才会完成目标).
classPractice.note: 课件 Reading slide 40 原题;Only when 引导状语从句置句首，主句倒装，把 will 提到主语 we 之前

classPractice.question: As with any great invention, we must be ____ of these problems and use the Internet responsibly.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;be aware of sth 意识到某事,固定搭配用介词 of

classPractice.question: This campaign aims to raise public ____ (aware) of the dangers of sharing personal information online.
classPractice.note: 冠词/物主前需名词;raise awareness of 提高……意识

classPractice.question: 我很清楚这些建议不容易执行。I am well ____ ____ these suggestions are not easy to carry out.
classPractice.note: be aware that + 从句;that 引导宾语从句不可省成 of

classPractice.question: She was suddenly ____ (aware / conscious) of every eye in the room fixed on her, though she had known all along they were watching.
classPractice.note: conscious 侧重当下直接的知觉;aware 更强调因了解、留意而"知道"

translation: （互联网上）冲浪，浏览；进行冲浪运动
original_sentence: However, it also raises all sorts of questions: when surfing the Internet, how can we protect ourselves?
readingExamples: However, it also raises all sorts of questions: when surfing the Internet, how can we protect ourselves?
definitionEn:
(1) v. to move around and look at various websites or content on the Internet, usually in a relaxed, unhurried way
(2) v. to ride on or along waves on a surfboard as a sport
(3) n. the white bubbly water formed by waves as they break near the shore

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 拍岸的碎浪、浪花（不可数）
uncommonMeanings.example: She stood where the cold surf swirled around her ankles, staring out at the horizon as if the answer to all her troubles lay somewhere beyond the waves. （读后续写·海边独白·环境烘托）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （channel-surf）不停换台;（借势）顺势而为，趁势前进
uncommonMeanings.example: Riding the surge of public enthusiasm, the young activist surfed a wave of support that carried her cause farther than she had ever dreamed. （读后续写/议论文·借势·比喻用法）

posExamples.sentence: Late that night, unable to sleep, I surfed the Internet aimlessly until a heartfelt blog about a lonely stray dog stopped my scrolling thumb dead in its tracks. （读后续写·夜晚·情节触发）
May I remind everyone that surfing the Internet during self-study periods not only wastes precious time but also disturbs the classmates seated around you. （应用文·通知/倡议·提醒）
Many students claim they merely surf the web to relax, yet hours vanish before they realise how little of real value they have gained. （议论文·网络与时间·论证）
As dawn broke over the bay, the local boys were already out surfing the towering waves, their laughter ringing across the water like the cry of gulls. （读后续写·冲浪运动·画面感）

wordForms.noun: surf (碎浪、浪花) / surfer (冲浪者、上网者) / surfing (冲浪运动、上网) / surfboard (冲浪板)
wordForms.other: 词族:surf(v./n.)→surfer(人)→surfing(动名词/运动名)→surfboard(冲浪板)。贴士:surf the Internet 里 surf 是及物动词,直接接宾语,不加介词(不说 surf on the Internet)。go surfing 表示去做某项运动,go + doing 结构(cf. go swimming/shopping)。

collocations.translation: 上网浏览、网上冲浪（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: However, it also raises all sorts of questions: when surfing the Internet, how can we protect ourselves? （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 上网时（现在分词作时间状语,主句主语与之一致）
collocations.example: When surfing the Internet, never click on links from strangers. 上网时,千万别点陌生人发来的链接。

collocations.phrase: surf the Internet / the web / the net
collocations.example: Instead of surfing the web all evening, why not pick up the novel that has been gathering dust on your shelf? （议论文·生活方式）
To surf the waves is to make peace with the sea's wildness rather than to fight against it. （读后续写·哲思/运动）
He lay slumped on the sofa, channel-surfing without interest, his mind a thousand miles away from the flickering screen. （读后续写·心不在焉）

collocations.translation: 从一个网站跳到另一个网站
collocations.example: She surfed from site to site in search of scholarship information, jotting down every promising lead. （读后续写·目标明确）
Every summer holiday, the whole family would drive to the coast and go surfing until the sun dipped below the sea. （读后续写·家庭回忆）
The crashing surf drowned out her sobs, and for once she let herself cry without fear of being heard. （读后续写·情绪释放）

synonyms.example: I love to browse the shelves of an old bookshop, never quite knowing what treasure I might stumble upon. （读后续写·惬意）
synonyms.usage: browse 强调随意翻看、无目的地浏览(网页、书店、商品),语气较文雅;surf 特指'在网上冲浪',更口语、更强调网页间的快速跳转

synonyms.example: She scrolled endlessly through the photos, each one dragging her deeper into memories she had tried to forget. （读后续写·回忆）
synonyms.usage: scroll 具体指用手指/鼠标滑动屏幕这一动作,常带'机械、无意识'的贬义;surf 更笼统地指浏览行为本身

advancedExpressions.expression: surf the Internet / the web / the net;go surfing;channel-surf;surf from site to site
advancedExpressions.example: 网上浏览一律用 surf the Internet/web/net;去冲浪运动用 go surfing;不停换台用 channel-surf。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示"上网浏览"
advancedExpressions.expression: surf the Internet / browse the web / go online / scroll through webpages
advancedExpressions.example: 只表"浏览网页"时可替换:surf the web ≈ browse the web ≈ go online。scroll 侧重滑屏动作。

advancedExpressions.expression: when surfing the Internet = when you are surfing the Internet
advancedExpressions.example: when/while + doing 是省略结构,分词逻辑主语须与主句主语一致:When surfing the net, be careful.（=When you are surfing）。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the surf crashing / roaring in the background
advancedExpressions.example: With the surf crashing rhythmically against the rocks, she finally found the courage to say the words she had rehearsed a hundred times. （以海浪声为背景音,烘托关键时刻）

advancedExpressions.expression: rather than surfing the Internet aimlessly, why not ...?
advancedExpressions.example: Rather than surfing the Internet aimlessly for hours on end, why not devote that time to a hobby that truly nourishes both body and mind? （反问句式劝诫,倡议信常用）

advancedExpressions.expression: to surf the web is not inherently harmful; what matters is ...
advancedExpressions.example: To surf the web is not inherently harmful; what truly matters is whether we control our screen time or let it quietly control us.

sentenceUpgrade.original: He surfed the Internet and found a sad story about a dog.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As he surfed the Internet late into the night, his thumb froze mid-scroll: there, glowing softly on the screen, was a photo of a shivering stray dog, its eyes brimming with a loneliness that mirrored his own. （读后续写·情节触发+移情）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语营造氛围(late into the night) + 动作定格(thumb froze mid-scroll) + there 引导倒装 + 以物喻情(mirrored his own)

sentenceUpgrade.original: People waste too much time surfing the web.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Countless hours, once spent reading, exercising or talking face to face, now dissolve unnoticed into the endless act of surfing the web — a quiet theft of time that few of us ever seem to protest. （议论文·科技反思）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 对比过去与现在(once spent... now dissolve) + dissolve unnoticed 生动动词 + 破折号追加评论(a quiet theft of time)

classPractice.question: It also raises all sorts of questions: when ____ (surf) the Internet, how can we protect ourselves?
classPractice.note: 课文原句;when + doing 分词作时间状语,逻辑主语 we 与主句一致

classPractice.question: Every summer the whole family drives to the coast and ____ ____ (去冲浪) until sunset.
classPractice.note: go + doing 表从事某项运动;主语 family 视为整体用单数 goes

classPractice.question: Many students claim they merely ____ (surf / scroll) the web to relax, yet hours vanish before they notice.
classPractice.note: surf the web 上网浏览(固定搭配);scroll 侧重手指滑屏这一具体动作

original_sentence: The following guidelines may show you how to live in the digital world.
readingExamples: The following guidelines may show you how to live in the digital world.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a piece of advice or a rule that tells you how something should be done or how you should behave
(2) n. an official set of instructions or standards issued by an organisation or authority
(3) n. (usually plural) a general principle or framework that shapes decisions or actions

posExamples.sentence: Clutching the crumpled sheet of safety guidelines her grandfather had scribbled years ago, she suddenly understood that his caution had been nothing but love in disguise. （读后续写·细节·情感领悟）
The following guidelines are designed to help every member enjoy our online forum safely, so please read them carefully before posting. （应用文·通知·规则说明）
Without clear guidelines to govern their behaviour, users of social media can easily drift into rudeness, deception or even outright harm. （议论文·网络秩序·论证）
The old fisherman's simple guideline — 'never turn your back on the sea' — echoed in my mind the very moment the rogue wave rose behind us. （读后续写·箴言应验·悬念）

wordForms.noun: guideline / guide (向导、指南) / guidance (指导、辅导)
wordForms.other: 词族:guide(v./n.)→guideline(具体指导条文,常用复数 guidelines)→guidance(不可数,抽象的"指导、辅导")。贴士:guideline 多用复数,表示一整套准则(follow the guidelines);guidance 不可数(under the guidance of 在……指导下)。构词:guide + line→"指导线",引申为"准则"。

collocations.phrase: establish / issue / lay down / draw up guidelines on sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】就……确立 / 发布 / 制订准则
collocations.example: The government has drawn up detailed guidelines on how personal data should be collected and stored. （课件·Reading slide 41）

collocations.translation: 以下准则、下列指导方针（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The following guidelines may show you how to live in the digital world. （课文原句）
As long as we all follow the safety guidelines, the field trip is sure to run smoothly. （应用文·活动通知）
The student council drew up a set of clear guidelines to keep our reading corner tidy and welcoming. （应用文·活动方案）
The school has laid down strict guidelines on the responsible use of smartphones during lessons. （议论文/应用文·规章）
These broad guidelines leave enough room for each class to adapt the plan to its own needs. （应用文·灵活性）
Ignoring the safety guidelines even once can turn a joyful outing into a tragedy. （议论文·安全意识）
Our teacher handed out clear guidelines for writing a persuasive essay, and my confidence grew with every point I read. （应用文·学习）
Let honesty serve as your guideline whenever you are tempted to take the easy but crooked path. （议论文·品格）

collocations.translation: 在准则范围内;按照准则
collocations.example: Everything the volunteers did was strictly within the guidelines set by the charity. （应用文·规范）

synonyms.example: He lived his whole life by one unshakeable principle: never let a friend down. （读后续写·品格）
synonyms.usage: principle 指内在、抽象的根本原则,层次更高、更恒定;guideline 是具体、可操作的指导条文,可修改

synonyms.example: Breaking the rule just this once, she told herself, would surely do no harm — how wrong she was. （读后续写·转折伏笔）
synonyms.usage: rule 具有强制性,违反会受罚;guideline 语气较柔,是建议性的指导,不遵守未必受罚

synonyms.example: The judges held every contestant to the same high standard, and no amount of charm could lower the bar. （议论文·公平）
synonyms.usage: standard 指衡量优劣、是否达标的尺度;guideline 侧重'怎么做'的方向性指引,而非合格线

advancedExpressions.expression: establish / issue / lay down / draw up guidelines on sth
advancedExpressions.example: 确立用 establish；发布用 issue；制订用 lay down / draw up；后接 on sth 表示"就……"。（课件·Reading slide 41）

advancedExpressions.expression: follow / observe the guidelines;set / draw up guidelines;lay down guidelines;guidelines on/for sth

original_sentence: One wrong click may damage your computer and remove all your computer files!
readingExamples: One wrong click may damage your computer and remove all your computer files!
definitionEn:
(1) v. to take something away from a place, or take it off something else
(2) v. to get rid of something unwanted, such as a stain, a doubt, a file, or an obstacle
(3) v. to dismiss someone from a position, job, or duty
(4) v. to take off clothing (formal)

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 距离;间隔;差距（多用于 at one/a remove from：与……有一定距离/隔阂）
uncommonMeanings.example: Watching the celebration from behind the glass, he felt himself at one remove from the joy of the crowd, as though happiness were a language he had never learned to speak. （读后续写·疏离感·心理刻画）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使消除（怀疑、疑虑、误会等抽象事物）

idioms.example: The glittering world of the film star was far removed from the muddy village lanes where she had spent her barefoot childhood. （读后续写·今昔对比）

A single honest conversation was enough to remove the suspicion that had poisoned their friendship for years. （读后续写·和解）

collocations.phrase: remove sb from office / a post
collocations.example: The corrupt official was finally removed from office, and the townsfolk celebrated far into the night. （议论文/叙事·正义得伸）
Before selling the old laptop, remember to remove all personal files to protect your privacy. （应用文·网络安全）
His grand promises were so far removed from reality that few in the audience took them seriously. （议论文·批判）
He removed his cap and bowed his head in silence before the memorial, and the whole square seemed to hold its breath. （读后续写·庄重场景）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示"删除、去掉"

advancedExpressions.example: 只表"删除文件"这一功能时可替换:remove a file ≈ delete a file ≈ get rid of a file;eliminate 语气最强,指彻底根除。

advancedExpressions.expression: re-(回/离/再)+词根:remove(移开)、replace(替换)、recover(恢复)

advancedExpressions.expression: in that instant, all her doubts were removed

sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: With painstaking care, as though handling something sacred, she removed the yellowed photograph from its frame — and there, tucked behind it, lay a folded note whose faded ink would rewrite everything she thought she knew about her mother. （读后续写·发现+悬念）

original_sentence: One wrong click may damage your computer and remove all your computer files!
readingExamples: One wrong click may damage your computer and remove all your computer files!
definitionEn:
(1) n. a collection of information about a particular person or subject, kept together in a folder or on a computer
(2) n. a folder, box, or cover for keeping loose papers together in order
(3) v. to store papers or information in a particular order or place
(4) v. to officially record something, such as a complaint or an application, with an authority
(5) v. to walk in a line, one behind another

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 文件、档案;（电脑）文件（课文义:computer files 电脑文件）
uncommonMeanings.example: One wrong click may remove all your computer files! 一次误点可能删除你所有的电脑文件!

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 正式提出（申请、诉讼、投诉）;提交（file a complaint 提出投诉）
uncommonMeanings.example: Determined to see justice done, she filed a formal complaint against the company, undaunted by the powerful enemies she was making. （读后续写·抗争·勇气）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 把（文件）归档、存档（file documents away / file sth under ...）
uncommonMeanings.example: Having filed the last of the papers away, the tired clerk switched off the light and headed home. （读后续写·日常）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （人们）鱼贯而行;排成一行行进（file in / out / past）
uncommonMeanings.example: One by one the exhausted soldiers filed past the memorial, each pausing to lay a single white flower at the foot of the cold grey stone. （读后续写·庄严队列·画面感）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 锉刀（打磨金属的工具）;v. 用锉刀锉
uncommonMeanings.example: Hour after hour the old locksmith filed at the rusty key, until at last it slid into the ancient lock with a satisfying click. （读后续写·匠心·细节）

posExamples.sentence: As the detective opened the dusty file, a single photograph slipped out and fluttered to the floor — the very face he had been hunting for twenty long years. （读后续写·线索·悬念）
Please remember to save your project as a separate file and back it up online, so that a sudden power cut can never wipe out weeks of hard work. （应用文·须知/提示）
Rather than piling documents on your desk in hopeless confusion, file them neatly by date, and you will save yourself hours of frantic searching. （议论文/应用文·效率·建议）
When the fire alarm rang, the pupils filed calmly out of the classroom in a single orderly line, just as their teacher had drilled them a hundred times. （读后续写·纪律·紧张场景）

wordForms.other: 一词多义总览:①n. 文件/档案/电脑文件(computer file);②n. 文件夹;③v. 归档(file away);④v. 正式提交、提出(file a complaint/claim);⑤v. 鱼贯而行(file in/out/past);⑥n./v. 锉刀/锉。贴士:in single file 成一列纵队(单数,无 s);on file 存档在案。这些义项都源于"一条线、一叠东西"的核心意象。

idioms.example: Roped together for safety, the climbers moved in single file along the narrow ridge, the valley yawning dizzily far below. （读后续写·登山·危险）
Every suggestion you send us will be kept on file and given careful thought before the final plan is announced. （应用文·回复）
It was not the generals but the rank and file who bore the true weight of the long, bitter war. （议论文/叙事·平民视角）

collocations.translation: 删除你所有的电脑文件（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: One wrong click may damage your computer and remove all your computer files! （课文原句）

collocations.translation: 提出投诉/索赔/报告（v. 正式提交,重点搭配）
collocations.example: After weeks of poor service, the residents finally filed a complaint with the housing office. （议论文/应用文·维权）
Always save your file before closing the programme, or a moment's carelessness may cost you an evening's work. （应用文·电脑提示）
One wrong click may remove every file on your computer, so handle unfamiliar links with the greatest of caution. （应用文·网络安全）
She uploaded the finished file just seconds before the deadline, her heart pounding with relief. （读后续写·紧张时刻）

collocations.phrase: keep a file on sb / sth
collocations.example: The library keeps a detailed file on every rare manuscript in its care. （应用文·记录）

The nurse handled each patient's confidential file with the utmost care and discretion. （应用文·职业素养）
As the final notes faded, the audience filed out of the concert hall in reverent silence, unwilling to break the spell. （读后续写·音乐会）

synonyms.example: His school record was spotless, yet behind those neat grades lay a story of quiet struggle no one had ever guessed. （读后续写·反差）

advancedExpressions.expression: one by one, they filed past ...

advancedExpressions.expression: be sure to save your work as a file and keep a backup

sentenceUpgrade.original: The detective opened the file and a photo fell out.

(3) vi. (belong to) to be the property of someone

collocations.translation: 【课件】属于（某人）（不用于进行时态和被动语态）
collocations.example: The book belongs to Dan. 这本书是丹的。（课件·Grammar slide 1）

collocations.translation: 【课件】是……的成员 / 属于……的一部分
collocations.example: Lions and tigers belong to the cat family. 狮子和老虎属于猫科。（课件·Grammar slide 1）

collocations.translation: 【课件】归属感（belonging 作不可数名词）
collocations.example: Joining the club gave the shy boy a sense of belonging he had never known. 加入社团让这个害羞的男孩有了从未有过的归属感。（课件·Grammar slide 3）

collocations.translation: 【课件】财产、所有物、财物 / 个人财物（恒用复数）
collocations.example: He packs his bike and a few belongings and heads out to find the girl. 他收拾好自行车和一些物品，出门去找女孩。（课件·Grammar slide 3）

collocations.phrase: a website belonging to all dance lovers
collocations.translation: 一个属于所有舞蹈爱好者的网站（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: JustDance is a website belonging to all dance lovers. （课文原句;belonging 现在分词作后置定语,相当于 which belongs to）

collocations.translation: 归属感（belonging 作名词,重点表达）
collocations.example: Joining the club gave the shy boy a sense of belonging he had never known. 加入社团让这个害羞的男孩有了从未有过的归属感。
The battered violin belonged to her late grandfather, and every string still seemed to carry his gentle voice. （读后续写·睹物思人）

collocations.phrase: belong to a club / team / group
collocations.translation: 是某俱乐部 / 队伍 / 团体的一员
collocations.example: Belonging to the debate team taught me not only how to argue but how to listen. （应用文·经历分享）
Watching the two old friends finish each other's sentences, I knew they belonged together. （读后续写·友情）

collocations.translation: 属于这里 / 那里;适应这里
collocations.example: The stray cat curled up on the doorstep as if it had always belonged here. （读后续写·温情画面）
Joining the volunteer programme, many left-behind children began to feel a sense of belonging they had long been denied. （议论文·教育关怀）
Such outdated prejudices belong in the past and have no place in a modern, open-minded campus. （议论文·观念革新）

collocations.translation: 知道自己的位置 / 归属
collocations.example: After years of drifting from job to job, he finally knew where he belonged: back on the family farm. （读后续写·回归）

synonyms.example: It took only a week for the exchange student to fit in, thanks to classmates who went out of their way to include her. （读后续写·融入）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:fit in 强调主动适应环境、与他人相处融洽的过程;belong 更强调那种由内而生的归属感与身份认同

synonyms.example: The dusty files pertaining to the old case had long been forgotten in the archive. （应用文·正式陈述）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:pertain to 是正式书面语,多用于文件、事务的从属或关联关系;belong to 更口语、更常用于所有权与成员身份

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·belong 用法(vi.应在某处;belong to 不用进行/被动)
advancedExpressions.expression: belong 是不及物动词，后必带介词或副词：belong to sb/sth（属于/是成员）、belong here/there（应在某处，= where it belongs），且不用进行时、不用被动语态
advancedExpressions.example: Put the chair back where it belongs.（课件·Grammar slide 1）The book belongs to Dan.（不说 is belonged to / is belonging to）Lions and tigers belong to the cat family.

advancedExpressions.expression: belong to sb/sth;belong here/there;belong together;a sense of belonging;belong in the past
advancedExpressions.example: "属于"用 belong to;"应在某处"用 belong here/there;"归属感"用 a sense of belonging。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示"有归属感、融入"
advancedExpressions.expression: belong / fit in / feel at home / be part of the group
advancedExpressions.example: 只表"融入、有归属感"时可替换:she felt she belonged ≈ she fitted in ≈ she felt at home。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·belong 不及物、不用被动/进行
advancedExpressions.expression: belong 是 vi.,后必带介词或副词(to/here/together),且无被动、无进行时
advancedExpressions.example: 正确:This book belongs to me.（不说 is belonged to me / is belonging to me）。这是高考常见陷阱。

advancedExpressions.expression: for the first time, sb. felt they belonged
advancedExpressions.example: As the whole class rose to applaud her clumsy first performance, tears blurred her vision — for the first time in her life, she felt she truly belonged. （情感反转+集体接纳,续写高潮段）

advancedExpressions.expression: so that everyone can feel they belong
advancedExpressions.example: I sincerely propose that we pair each freshman with a senior buddy, so that everyone, from the very first day, can feel they belong. （建议信中提出具体举措+目的状语）

advancedExpressions.expression: a genuine sense of belonging is the foundation of ...
advancedExpressions.example: A genuine sense of belonging is the foundation of any thriving community, for people who feel valued are far more willing to contribute. （中心句+for引导原因论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She finally felt she belonged.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: As the last note of the choir faded and dozens of unfamiliar hands reached out to pull her into the circle, something inside her quietly settled — after all those lonely months, she finally, unmistakably belonged. （读后续写·心理描写+画面感）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as引导时间状语铺陈画面 + something settled 具象化心理变化 + 副词叠加(finally, unmistakably)强化情感落点

sentenceUpgrade.original: Belonging to a group is important.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that belonging to a supportive group is not a luxury but a necessity, for it is within such circles that self-doubt gives way to confidence and isolation to strength. （议论文·正式立论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...正式立论 + not...but...对比强调 + for引导原因 + 两组抽象名词对照(self-doubt→confidence, isolation→strength)

classPractice.type: 语境应用·句型转换（课件）
classPractice.question: The boy is a member of a football club and plays every Saturday. → The boy ____ ____ a football club and plays every Saturday.
classPractice.note: 课件 Grammar slide 2 原题;be a member of = belong to 是……的成员;主语 The boy 第三人称单数用 belongs to

classPractice.question: JustDance is a website ____ (belong) to all dance lovers.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;现在分词作后置定语(=which belongs to),belong 无被动故不用 belonged

classPractice.question: 加入社团给了这个害羞的男孩一种前所未有的归属感。Joining the club gave the shy boy a ____ of ____ he had never known.
classPractice.note: a sense of belonging 归属感;belonging 此处为不可数名词

classPractice.question: Please don't leave your personal ____ (belonging / belongings) on the seat when you get off the bus.
classPractice.note: belongings 恒用复数,指随身财物;belonging(不可数)才是"归属感"

classPractice.question: This old violin ____ (belong) to my grandfather; it has never been mine. (用一般现在时的正确形式)
classPractice.note: belong 不及物、不用被动/进行;主语 violin 第三人称单数用 belongs to

original_sentence: JustDance is a website belonging to all dance lovers.
readingExamples: JustDance is a website belonging to all dance lovers.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to be the property of a particular person; to be owned by someone
(2) phr. to be a member of a particular group, organization, or class
(3) phr. to be connected with or a part of a particular thing, time, or place

posExamples.sentence: The moment she opened the worn leather case, she realized the medal must once have belonged to a soldier who never came home. （读后续写·遗物寻踪）
Everyone is warmly welcome to join, for our reading club belongs to all who love a good story, regardless of grade or background. （应用文·社团招新）
The future belongs to those who dare to dream and, more importantly, who have the perseverance to turn those dreams into reality. （议论文·青年与理想）
That crumbling castle belongs to a bygone age, yet standing beneath its arches, I could almost hear the echoes of centuries past. （读后续写·历史遗迹）

wordForms.verb: belong to (属于;为……所有;是……的成员)
wordForms.other: 铁律:belong to 是不及物动词短语,永远不用被动语态、不用进行时——只说 belongs to / belonged to,绝不说 is belonged to 或 is belonging to。它与 be owned by 意思相近,但 own 才可用被动(be owned by)。语义:①归……所有(所有权);②是……的成员;③属于某时代/类别。

idioms.idiom: belong to (do not use passive / continuous)
idioms.translation: 属于（习语性搭配:不用被动语态、不用进行时）
idioms.example: This bike belongs to my brother.（正确）而非 is belonged to / is belonging to my brother.（错误）

idioms.idiom: the future belongs to those who ...
idioms.example: The future belongs to those who dare to dream and have the perseverance to make those dreams come true. （名言式论断）

collocations.phrase: a website belonging to all dance lovers
collocations.translation: 一个属于所有舞蹈爱好者的网站（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: JustDance is a website belonging to all dance lovers. （课文原句;belong to 的现在分词形式作后置定语）
The abandoned puppy now belongs to the whole village, fed and cherished by every household in turn. （读后续写·集体温情）

collocations.translation: 是某团体 / 组织的成员
collocations.example: Belonging to the Red Cross Society opened my eyes to how much a single pair of willing hands can accomplish. （应用文·志愿经历）

collocations.phrase: belong to the past / a bygone era
collocations.translation: 属于过去 / 逝去的时代
collocations.example: Handwritten letters may belong to a bygone era, yet the intimacy they carry can never be replaced by an instant message. （议论文·传统与现代）
These ancient forests do not belong to us alone; they belong to future generations, and it is our duty to protect them. （议论文·环境保护）
Our headmaster reminded us that the future belongs to the well-read and the open-minded. （应用文·演讲）
Though wildly different in style, both novels belong to the same category of coming-of-age stories. （议论文·文学评析）

synonyms.example: The sprawling estate was once owned by a shipping magnate whose fortune had long since vanished. （读后续写·家族兴衰）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be owned by 用被动语态,主语是被拥有的物,强调所有权;belong to 主语同样是物,但更自然常用,且可延伸表成员身份与归属

synonyms.example: Being a member of the school choir gave the timid boy a stage on which to finally find his voice. （读后续写·成长）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be a member of 专指对组织、团体的成员身份;belong to 涵盖面更广,既能表成员,也能表所有权与归属感

advancedExpressions.expression: belong to sb;belong to a group;belong to the past/a bygone era;belong to future generations
advancedExpressions.example: 表所有权用 belong to sb;表成员身份用 belong to a group;表时代归属用 belong to a bygone era。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·功能:表示"属于、归……所有"
advancedExpressions.expression: belong to / be owned by / be the property of / be a member of
advancedExpressions.example: 只表"归……所有"这一功能时可替换:it belongs to him ≈ it is owned by him ≈ it is his property。表成员用 be a member of。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·belong to 不用被动/进行时
advancedExpressions.expression: belong to 恒用主动、一般时:X belongs to Y,不说 X is belonged to Y / is belonging to Y
advancedExpressions.example: 高考陷阱:主语是"被拥有的物",但仍用主动 belongs to;若要用被动只能换 be owned by。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. realized that ... had once belonged to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Turning the faded photograph over, she realized that the very courage she now summoned had once belonged to the grandmother staring back at her. （物件牵出传承主题,续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: this ... belongs to all of us, so let us ...
advancedExpressions.example: This campus belongs to all of us, so let us each play our part in keeping it clean, green and welcoming. （倡议书结尾,belongs to all强化集体责任）

advancedExpressions.expression: the future belongs to those who ...
advancedExpressions.example: The future belongs to those who refuse to be discouraged by failure and keep striving in the face of adversity. （名言式论断,who定语从句概括论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: The bike belongs to my brother.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The rusty old bike leaning against the wall belonged to my brother — every dent and scratch a silent record of the reckless, sunlit summers we had spent racing down the hill together. （读后续写·睹物怀旧）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 现在分词短语(leaning against the wall)补充画面 + 破折号追加抒情 + every dent...a record 名词化隐喻承载回忆

sentenceUpgrade.original: This planet belongs to everyone.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: This planet belongs not to any single nation or generation but to all who now breathe its air and all who are yet to come; safeguarding it, therefore, is a duty from which no one may excuse himself. （议论文·环保立论）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: not to...but to...递进否定 + all who...平行结构涵盖当下与未来 + therefore顺承推出责任 + from which定语从句收束

classPractice.question: JustDance is a website ____ (belong) to all dance lovers, whatever their level.
classPractice.note: 课文原句;现在分词作后置定语,=which belongs to;belong 无被动

classPractice.question: 改错:This valuable painting is belonged to a famous collector. 正确形式:This valuable painting ____ ____ a famous collector.
classPractice.note: belong to 不用被动语态,直接用主动 belongs to

classPractice.question: 未来属于那些敢于追梦并坚持不懈的人。The future ____ ____ those who dare to dream and never give up.
classPractice.note: the future belongs to sb 名言式结构;主语 future 用第三人称单数 belongs

classPractice.question: These ancient forests do not ____ (belong to / be owned by) us alone; they are for future generations too.
classPractice.note: belong to 用主动、更自然;be owned by 是被动结构,此处句式为主动故选 belong to

translation: 芭蕾舞；芭蕾舞剧；芭蕾舞团
original_sentence: My daughter just loved her ballet classes.
readingExamples: My daughter just loved her ballet classes.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a type of dancing in which controlled and graceful movements, along with dramatic action, are used to tell a story to music
(2) n. a particular work or performance of this kind of dancing
(3) n. a group of dancers who perform ballet together; a ballet company

posExamples.sentence: The instant the music swelled, the little girl rose onto her toes, and the whole studio held its breath as her first ballet seemed to lift her clear off the ground. （读后续写·初次登台）
We warmly invite all parents to our year-end ballet performance, where months of hard work and quiet perseverance will finally take the spotlight. （应用文·活动邀请）
Far from being a mere display of elegance, ballet demands an iron discipline and endurance that few other art forms can rival. （议论文·艺术与毅力）
After years of blistered feet and bruised pride, she was at last offered a place in the national ballet, and the tears she wept were of pure vindication. （读后续写·梦想成真）

wordForms.other: dancer (舞者·泛指)

collocations.example: My daughter just loved her ballet classes. （课文原句）
Behind every effortless leap of a ballet dancer lie thousands of hours of unseen, aching practice. （议论文·天赋与努力）
My daughter just loved her ballet classes, chattering all the way home about pliés and pirouettes. （读后续写·童趣）
To dance ballet at that level, she confessed, was to make the impossible look as natural as breathing. （读后续写·访谈感悟）
Being admitted to the country's most prestigious ballet company was a dream she had nurtured since the age of five. （读后续写·梦想）
The charity ballet performance drew a full house and raised a considerable sum for children in remote areas. （应用文·公益活动）
She laced up her worn ballet shoes one final time, determined to make this farewell performance unforgettable. （读后续写·告别）
Encouraged by her supportive teacher, the once-clumsy girl took up ballet and slowly blossomed into a confident performer. （读后续写·成长蜕变）

synonyms.example: Through dance she expressed the joy and grief that words had always failed to capture. （读后续写·情感表达）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:dance 是舞蹈的统称,涵盖各种形式;ballet 特指讲究足尖、姿态与叙事的古典芭蕾,是 dance 的一个具体分支

synonyms.example: The award-winning choreography blended classical elegance with bold, modern energy. （应用文·演出评介）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:choreography 指舞蹈动作的设计与编排(幕后创作);ballet 指芭蕾这一舞种或具体演出本身,两者层面不同

advancedExpressions.expression: ballet → ballerina（芭蕾女演员）
advancedExpressions.example: The little girl dreamed of one day becoming a ballerina on the grandest stage. （名词后缀 -ina 常表女性表演者，如 ballerina; 男舞者用 ballet dancer / danseur）

advancedExpressions.expression: ballet 泛指"芭蕾（舞种）"不可数; 指"一部芭蕾舞剧/一场演出"可数
advancedExpressions.example: She studies ballet (不可数·舞种); We watched a famous ballet last night (可数·一部剧). （同一词随语义在可数/不可数间切换，做题看有无冠词与语义）

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. rose onto their toes, and ...
advancedExpressions.example: She rose onto her toes, arms unfurling like the wings of a waking swan, and for one breathless moment the entire hall forgot to applaud. （比喻+慢镜头定格,续写画面渲染）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cordially invite you to our ... ballet ...
advancedExpressions.example: We cordially invite you to our charity ballet gala, an evening where grace meets generosity in support of a worthy cause. （邀请函措辞正式优雅+同位语点明意义）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being merely ..., ballet demands ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being merely a graceful spectacle, ballet demands a discipline of body and mind that shapes character as much as it shapes technique. （far from纠偏惯常认知+demands引出深层价值）

sentenceUpgrade.original: She danced ballet beautifully on the stage.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Under the golden spotlight she seemed to melt into the music, every turn and leap of her ballet so weightless that the audience half believed she had shed the burden of gravity itself. （读后续写·表演画面）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 环境铺垫(golden spotlight) + melt into比喻融入 + so...that结果状语夸张 + shed the burden of gravity 拟人化升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: Learning ballet is very hard.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Mastering ballet is far from the effortless art it appears to be; behind each fluid movement lie years of blistered toes, endless repetition, and a resolve that refuses to bend. （议论文·努力与坚持）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: far from...纠正表象 + behind...lie 倒装凸显付出 + 三项并列名词短语(blistered toes, repetition, resolve)层层加重

classPractice.question: My daughter just loved her ____ (ballet) classes and talked about them all the way home.
classPractice.note: 课文原句; ballet 作定语修饰 classes，此处用原形，无需变形

classPractice.question: 受老师鼓励，这个曾经笨拙的女孩开始学芭蕾。Encouraged by her teacher, the once-clumsy girl ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: take up ballet "开始学芭蕾"; take up 表"开始从事（爱好/活动）"

classPractice.question: Through ____ (dance / ballet) she expressed emotions, and classical ____ (dance / ballet) with its pointe work became her favourite branch of it.
classPractice.note: dance 是舞蹈统称; ballet 特指讲究足尖姿态的古典芭蕾，是 dance 的一个分支

original_sentence: Fiona wanted to introduce more people to dance, so she set up JustDance.
readingExamples: Fiona wanted to introduce more people to dance, so she set up JustDance.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to start or create a business, organization, system, or event
(2) phr. to build or place something somewhere; to put equipment or furniture in position and make it ready for use
(3) phr. to arrange for something to happen; to make plans for an activity or event
(4) phr. to establish or found something so that it can begin operating

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 陷害;设局诬陷(使某人显得有罪)
uncommonMeanings.example: As the false evidence piled up against him, the truth slowly dawned: he had been set up by the very colleague he trusted most. （读后续写·反转·蒙冤）

posExamples.sentence: Fired by the memory of children who had no library of their own, she quietly set up a small book-donation drive that would one day reach thousands. （读后续写·善举起点）
To meet the growing demand, we plan to set up a recycling station in every corridor and would greatly appreciate your active cooperation. （应用文·倡议书）
Governments that set up robust support systems for young entrepreneurs invariably reap the rewards of a more innovative economy. （议论文·政策与创新）
By the time the sun dipped below the hills, we had set up our tents in a neat row and lit a crackling fire to keep the night chill at bay. （读后续写·野营）

idioms.example: With little more than a battered cart and boundless optimism, the young couple set up shop on the busy street corner. （读后续写·白手起家）

collocations.phrase: set up a business / set up his own business
collocations.example: His aim is to set up his own business. （课件·set up = establish 创建）

collocations.translation: 【课件】竖立，架起，建造（make a piece of equipment ready）
collocations.example: I need one or two people to help me set up the camera. （课件·把设备架好备用）
We need to set up a meeting to discuss the proposals. （课件·安排会议）
The slump on Wall Street set up a chain reaction in stock markets. （课件·引发连锁反应）
You must be careful when setting off fireworks. （课件·set 短语完成句子·放烟火）
He liked the novel so much that he set aside his own work and translated it into German. （课件·set 短语完成句子·放下自己的工作）
They set out for Beijing early the next morning. （课件·set 短语完成句子·出发去北京）
Fiona wanted to introduce more people to dance, so she set up JustDance. （课文原句）
Straight out of university, she set up a business turning waste plastic into affordable school desks. （读后续写·环保创业）

collocations.phrase: set up an organization / charity / club
collocations.translation: 成立组织 / 慈善机构 / 社团
collocations.example: Fiona wanted to introduce more people to dance, so she set up JustDance, a website belonging to all dance lovers. （应用文·平台介绍）

collocations.translation: 建立一套系统 / 制度
collocations.example: The school set up a mentoring system pairing every freshman with an experienced senior. （应用文·制度介绍）
In memory of his late teacher, he set up a fund to support students who could not afford textbooks. （读后续写·感恩传承）

collocations.phrase: set up equipment / a tent / a stall
collocations.translation: 架设设备 / 搭帐篷 / 摆摊
collocations.example: Volunteers arrived at dawn to set up the stalls before the charity sale opened its doors. （应用文·活动筹备）

collocations.phrase: set up a meeting / an appointment
collocations.example: I have set up a meeting for next Monday so that we may discuss the details of the exchange programme. （应用文·邮件）
The tech-savvy students set up an online platform where classmates could freely share study resources. （议论文·科技赋能学习）
After years as an apprentice, he finally set himself up as an independent carpenter. （读后续写·独立创业）

synonyms.example: The foundation, established over a century ago, has quietly changed the fate of countless rural children. （议论文·慈善机构）

translation: vt. 要求，请求 | n. 要求，请求；要求的事

readingExamples: For example, she has requested a technical team to develop an app so as to satisfy different users' needs.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a polite or formal act of asking for something
(2) n. something that you have asked for; the thing being asked for
(3) vt. to ask for something in a polite or formal way
(4) vt. to ask someone politely or formally to do something

posExamples.sentence: For example, she has requested a technical team to develop an app so as to satisfy different users' needs. （应用文·平台介绍）

idioms.example: Detailed brochures about the exchange programme are available on request at the front desk. （应用文·信息说明）

collocations.translation: 要求某人做某事(虚拟语气)

collocations.translation: 礼貌的 / 合理的 / 紧急的请求

translation: 技术的，技能的；专门技术的；专业的

(2) adj. relating to machines, processes, and materials used in industry, transport, and communications
(3) adj. relating to a particular subject and difficult to understand for people without special knowledge
(4) adj. according to a strict interpretation of rules or facts

translation: adj. 可移动的，非固定的；行动方便的；流动的 | n. 手机
original_sentence: Users who access the Internet using mobile devices.
readingExamples: Users who access the Internet using mobile devices.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. able to move or be moved easily and quickly from one place to another
(2) adj. (of people) able to change social class, job or place of living
(3) adj. (of the face or features) changing quickly in expression
(4) n. (British English) a mobile phone; also a decorative structure hung up so that it moves in the air

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】瘫痪的；静止的（immobile，opp. of mobile）
uncommonMeanings.example: After the accident he lay immobile for weeks, unable to move so much as a finger. （课件·immobile 瘫痪的/静止的，mobile 的反义词）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （面部表情）多变的，善于变化的
uncommonMeanings.example: His was a wonderfully mobile face, and a whole storm of grief, doubt and finally hope chased one another across it before he uttered a single word. （读后续写·人物刻画·表情丰富）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （悬挂的）风动装饰，动态挂饰
uncommonMeanings.example: Above the baby's cradle hung a mobile of tiny paper cranes that turned lazily in the draught, scattering fragments of coloured light across the ceiling. （读后续写·温馨居所·挂饰）

posExamples.sentence: The rescue team set up a mobile clinic at the foot of the mountain, and within hours the tent was crowded with villagers who had walked for miles to be treated. （读后续写·灾后救援）
We are delighted to announce that a mobile library will visit our neighbourhood every Saturday, bringing hundreds of books right to your doorstep. （应用文·公告）
A truly mobile society, where talent rather than birth decides one's fate, is the surest sign of a fair and thriving nation. （议论文·社会公平）
The chart shows that a soaring number of users now access the Internet using mobile devices rather than desktop computers. （应用文·图表描述）

wordForms.noun: mobility (流动性 / 灵活性) / mobile (英式·手机)
wordForms.adjective: mobile (可移动的) / immobile (不能移动的)
wordForms.other: 词族: mobile(adj./n.) → mobility(n.流动性) → mobilize(v.动员) → mobilization(n.动员); 反义 immobile(不能动的); mobile 既是形容词"移动的"也是名词"手机"(英式)

collocations.example: Users who access the Internet using mobile devices. （课件·手机相关的 mobile equipment / 课文原句 mobile devices）

collocations.translation: 【课件】行动不便的；腿脚不灵便的
collocations.example: A kitchen especially designed for the elderly or people who are less mobile. （课件原句·less mobile 行动不便的）
Industrialization gradually turned a settled countryside into a mobile society. （课件·a mobile society 流动的社会）
Users who access the Internet using mobile devices. （课文原句）
She fumbled for her mobile phone in the dark, praying that a single bar of signal would appear. （读后续写·危急时刻）
More and more learning now happens on mobile devices, letting students study on the bus or in a queue. （议论文·数字学习）

collocations.translation: 流动图书馆 / 诊所 / 单位
collocations.example: The mobile clinic brought basic health care to remote villages that had never seen a doctor. （应用文·公益报道）

collocations.translation: 社会阶层可流动的 / 向上流动的
collocations.example: Education gave the miner's daughter a chance to become upwardly mobile, something her parents had never dared to dream of. （读后续写·奋斗）

collocations.translation: 机动性强的，流动性大的
collocations.example: A highly mobile workforce can respond swiftly wherever a disaster strikes. （议论文·社会效率）
Our school has launched a mobile app through which parents can check the timetable at a glance. （应用文·通知）

collocations.translation: 保持行动能力 / 保持活动
collocations.example: Gentle daily exercise helped the elderly man stay mobile well into his nineties. （议论文·健康养生）

synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:mobilize 是 mobile 的动词派生词，指"动员、调动（人力/资源/力量）"; mobile 本身是形容词"可移动的"/名词"手机"。勿混用词性

synonyms.translation: 【课件·派生词】流动性，灵活性（social mobility 社会流动性）

synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:mobility 是 mobile 的名词形式，指抽象的"流动性/机动性"(尤指 social mobility 社会阶层流动); mobile 是形容词。做词形变换题常考

synonyms.example: The classroom was fitted with movable desks that could be rearranged for group work in seconds. （应用文·校园说明）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·mobile 三大形容词义（课件）
advancedExpressions.expression: mobile(adj.): ①手机相关的、移动的 mobile equipment/devices ②行动方便的、腿脚灵便的 less mobile 行动不便 ③流动的 a mobile society; 另作名词=手机(英式)

advancedExpressions.expression: sb.'s mobile features betrayed every ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: He used a small device to call for help.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Fumbling in the darkness, he rigged up a crude signalling device from the wreckage, and with the last flicker of hope pulsing in his chest, he began flashing three short beams into the endless night. （读后续写·绝境求救）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(Fumbling in the darkness) + 生动动词(rigged up, flashing) + 心理描写(flicker of hope pulsing) + 数字细节(three short beams)

sentenceUpgrade.original: This device can help us save energy.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I sincerely believe that installing this simple yet ingenious device throughout the school would not only cut our energy bills but also nurture in every student a lasting sense of environmental responsibility. （应用文·建议信）

original_sentence: I was a smartphone addict.
readingExamples: I was a smartphone addict.
definitionEn:
(1) n. someone who is unable to stop taking harmful drugs, or unable to stop doing an activity that they enjoy in an unhealthy way
(2) n. (informal) someone who is extremely interested in a particular activity and spends as much time as possible on it
(3) vt. (usu. passive: be addicted to) to make someone unable to stop taking a drug or doing an activity

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）对某活动极度着迷的人，…迷
uncommonMeanings.example: As a self-confessed book addict, she could lose herself in a novel all afternoon. 作为自认的书迷，她能整个下午沉浸在小说里。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （常用被动 addict oneself to）使沉溺、使入迷
uncommonMeanings.example: For three whole years he had addicted himself to the roar of the crowd, and now, standing in the empty stadium, he wondered who he was without it. （读后续写·退役运动员·身份迷失）

posExamples.sentence: Once a hopeless game addict who greeted every dawn with bloodshot eyes, Tom now closed his laptop at nine sharp, laced up his running shoes, and let the cool morning air wash the screen-glow out of his mind. （读后续写·自律蜕变）
I am writing to warn my fellow students that many of us are becoming unwitting addicts of short videos, scrolling for hours while our textbooks gather dust on the desk. （应用文·倡议书）
It would be unfair to dismiss every heavy gamer as a hopeless addict, for the real problem lies not in the game itself but in our inability to set reasonable limits. （议论文·网络成瘾）
As a self-confessed book addict, Grandma could lose herself in a novel for an entire afternoon, deaf to the whistling kettle and the ringing phone. （读后续写·人物刻画）

wordForms.verb: addict（使上瘾，常用 be addicted to）
wordForms.adjective: addicted（上瘾的，成瘾者的） / addictive（使人上瘾的，有诱惑力的）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……入迷的人；手机成瘾者
collocations.example: I was a smartphone addict. 我曾是个手机成瘾者。

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……入迷的；成瘾的（addicted adj. 修饰人）
