collocations.translation: 【课件】让人入迷的（addictive adj. 修饰物）
collocations.example: I find jogging very addictive. 我觉得慢跑非常令人上瘾。
He is now fighting his addiction to alcohol. / ... his alcohol addiction. 他正努力戒除酒瘾。

collocations.phrase: be addicted to sth / doing sth
collocations.example: He is addicted to online games. 他沉迷于网络游戏。
Many teens quietly become addicts of short videos. 许多青少年不知不觉沉迷于短视频。
The documentary followed a former drug addict who, after years in the shadows, now devoted his life to steering teenagers away from the same abyss. （读后续写·救赎）
Refusing to be a smartphone addict any longer, she deleted every game and taped a note to her mirror: 'Look up and live.' （读后续写·自我救赎）
His parents feared he had become a gaming addict, for the boy who once loved football now spoke only to a glowing screen. （读后续写·家庭）
A self-proclaimed coffee addict, our teacher joked that his morning class simply would not happen without a steaming mug at his side. （应用文·人物介绍）
Everyone had written him off as a hopeless addict, yet within him still flickered a stubborn spark of the will to change. （读后续写·转折）
As a recovering addict, he measured his progress not in grand victories but in the small triumph of each phone-free evening. （读后续写·励志）

collocations.translation: 肾上腺素成瘾者（极限运动迷）
collocations.example: An adrenaline addict at heart, she chased one steep cliff after another, convinced that she felt most alive at the very edge of danger. （读后续写·探险）
Clever game designers know exactly which rewards can turn a curious child into an addict before he even realizes it. （议论文·科技伦理）

synonyms.example: A lifelong film enthusiast, Mr. Lee could recite entire scenes from memory, his eyes lighting up at the mere mention of a classic. （应用文·人物介绍）
synonyms.usage: 褒义、中性，指对某事物有健康而热烈的兴趣；不含'上瘾、失控'的贬义，可安全用于夸奖某人的爱好。

synonyms.example: 'You're such a news junkie,' his sister teased, watching him refresh the headlines for the tenth time before breakfast. （读后续写·对话）
synonyms.usage: 口语、俚语色彩极强，比 addict 更随意、略带调侃或贬损；正式作文中慎用，读后续写口语对话里可增添生活气息。

synonyms.example: As a fitness fanatic, she never let a rainy morning become an excuse to skip her five-kilometre run. （读后续写·自律）
synonyms.usage: 强调痴迷到近乎极端的程度，情感比 addict 更强烈；可褒可贬，视语境而定，常用于形容对运动、宗教、某项爱好的狂热。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·the first thing sb did was (to) do(主语含do时to可省)

advancedExpressions.expression: a smartphone addict｜be addicted to sth｜become / turn into an addict｜break an addiction
advancedExpressions.example: Once addicted to his phone, he fought hard to break the addiction and stop being a smartphone addict. 曾对手机上瘾的他，努力戒瘾，不再做手机成瘾者。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「上瘾/着迷」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be addicted to ≈ be hooked on ≈ can't stop doing ≈ be glued to（侧重视线）
advancedExpressions.example: He is addicted to / hooked on short videos and just can't stop scrolling. 他沉迷短视频，停不下来地刷。

advancedExpressions.expression: addict(n./v.) → addiction(n.瘾) → addicted(adj.人上瘾) / addictive(adj.物使人上瘾)
advancedExpressions.example: The addictive design turned him into an addict, and his addiction ruined his sleep. 这令人上瘾的设计把他变成瘾君子，他的瘾毁了睡眠。

advancedExpressions.expression: no longer a slave / addict to ..., sb. finally ...
advancedExpressions.example: No longer a slave to that little glowing screen, she finally lifted her eyes to the world and saw the sky she had ignored for years. （对比+隐喻，续写升华段展现觉醒）

advancedExpressions.expression: before we become addicts of ..., let us ...
advancedExpressions.example: Before we all become addicts of endless scrolling, let us reclaim our time and rediscover the quiet joys of reading, sport and real conversation. （倡议书结尾号召，before引导警示）

advancedExpressions.expression: the line between an enthusiast and an addict lies in ...
advancedExpressions.example: The line between a healthy enthusiast and a helpless addict lies not in how much we love something, but in whether we can still walk away from it. （对比句式，界定核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: He was addicted to his phone and could not stop.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The phone had become a second heartbeat he could not silence; like a true addict, he reached for it the instant a conversation paused, a queue formed, or a moment of stillness threatened to let his own thoughts catch up with him. （读后续写·心理描写+比喻）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 隐喻(a second heartbeat) + like a true addict 明喻 + 三项排比(a conversation paused / a queue formed / a moment of stillness threatened) 铺陈成瘾细节

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not let students become phone addicts.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is therefore incumbent upon both schools and families to act before more of our young people slide from casual users into helpless addicts, robbed of their focus, their sleep and, ultimately, their curiosity about the wider world. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is incumbent upon sb. to do 正式责任句式 + slide from ... into ... 渐变动词 + 三名词排比(focus, sleep, curiosity)递进强调后果

translation: 全神贯注看着某物，离某物很近
original_sentence: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street, had dinner with friends or lay in bed at night.
readingExamples: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street, had dinner with friends or lay in bed at night.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to keep looking at something with all your attention, especially a screen, so that you notice nothing else
(2) phr. to stay very close to something or someone and be unwilling to move away
(3) phr. (of the eyes/gaze) to be fixed firmly on something as if unable to look away

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 紧贴/寸步不离某人或某物，不愿离开
uncommonMeanings.example: The shy new boy stayed glued to his mother at the school gate. 害羞的新生在校门口寸步不离地黏着妈妈。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （因惊吓/震惊）呆立原地，动弹不得（be glued to the spot）
uncommonMeanings.example: She was glued to the spot, too frightened to run. 她惊呆在原地，吓得动都不敢动。

posExamples.sentence: For the whole flight the little boy sat glued to the window, his nose pressed against the cold glass, watching the clouds unfold beneath him like a vast field of snow. （读后续写·童真视角）
I have noticed that during meals many students remain glued to their phones, letting the food go cold and the family conversation die away. （应用文·倡议书）

When millions of citizens stay glued to their screens for hours a day, we must ask ourselves what precious things — time, health, real connection — are quietly slipping through our fingers. （议论文·数字生活）
As the final whistle approached, the entire class was glued to the live broadcast, hardly daring to breathe until the winning goal sent the room into a roar. （读后续写·集体场面）

wordForms.other: 习语固定用被动/过去分词:be / sit / stay glued to sth;keep one's eyes glued to sth。glue 原意'胶水/粘'，此处比喻'像被胶水粘住般盯着'。

idioms.translation: 目不转睛地盯着某物（习语，课文）
idioms.example: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street. （课文原句，习语出处）

idioms.idiom: be glued to the television / TV
idioms.example: Every Spring Festival Eve, the whole family would be glued to the television, laughing at the gala long past midnight. （读后续写·节日温情）

idioms.idiom: keep one's eyes glued to sth
idioms.example: She kept her eyes glued to the door, her heart leaping at every footstep, praying that the next one would be his. （读后续写·期盼）

collocations.translation: 【课件】全神贯注看着某物，离某物很近（to look at sth with all your attention）
collocations.example: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street. 无论走在街上，我的眼睛都紧盯着那块小屏幕。

collocations.phrase: keep one's eyes glued to sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】目不转睛地盯着某物（= be glued to sth）
collocations.example: We were glued to the television watching the election results come in. 我们目不转睛地盯着电视，等待大选结果揭晓。

collocations.translation: 【课件】（因感兴趣、惊讶、害怕等）像钉在原地似的一动不动
collocations.example: She stood glued to the spot, shocked by the scene in front of her. 她呆立原地，被眼前的景象惊住了。

collocations.phrase: glue A to/onto B (or glue A and B together)
collocations.translation: 【课件】把A粘到B上（glue 粘牢、粘贴）
collocations.example: He glued the broken handle back onto the cup. 他把断掉的把手重新粘回杯子上。

collocations.phrase: one's eyes are glued to sth
collocations.translation: 眼睛紧盯着某物，目不转睛（课文原句）
collocations.example: My eyes were glued to the little screen whenever I walked down the street, had dinner with friends or lay in bed at night. 无论走在街上、和朋友吃饭还是夜里躺在床上，我的眼睛都紧盯着那块小屏幕。

collocations.phrase: be / stay / sit glued to sth
collocations.translation: 目不转睛地盯着，一动不动地守着某物
collocations.example: The children sat glued to the TV all evening. 孩子们整晚一动不动地盯着电视。

collocations.phrase: be glued to the screen / phone
collocations.translation: 目不转睛地盯着屏幕／手机
collocations.example: Hour after hour he was glued to the screen, unaware that outside his window the sun had risen, blazed and finally sunk behind the hills. （读后续写·虚度光阴）
Eyes glued to the exam board, she scanned the endless list of names, her breath caught somewhere between hope and dread. （读后续写·放榜心理）
The children sat glued to the storyteller, their eyes wide, their half-eaten snacks forgotten in their hands. （读后续写·出神）
The frightened puppy remained glued to the boy's side, trembling at every stranger who passed. （读后续写·陪伴）

collocations.phrase: have one's face glued to the window
collocations.example: With his face glued to the window, the child counted the raindrops racing down the glass, willing the storm to pass. （读后续写·等待）

synonyms.example: So absorbed was she in the novel that she never heard the bell ring or the classroom empty around her. （读后续写·倒装+专注）
synonyms.usage: 强调'沉浸投入'的积极专注，多用于阅读、工作、思考；比 be glued to 更书面、更褒义，可安全用于议论文正面论述。

synonyms.example: For weeks he was fixated on that one mistake, replaying it endlessly until it swallowed every other thought. （读后续写·心理执念）
synonyms.usage: 带有'过度、不健康地聚焦'的贬义，侧重心理上的执迷；be glued to 更侧重视线／身体的固定，fixated 更侧重内心的执着。

synonyms.example: Within a single evening she was hooked on the mystery series, promising herself 'just one more episode' until the sky turned grey. （读后续写·上瘾）
synonyms.usage: 口语化，强调'着迷上瘾、欲罢不能'，偏重持续性的兴趣或习惯；be glued to 侧重此刻的目不转睛，二者可搭配使用增强层次。

advancedExpressions.expression: be glued to the screen｜keep one's eyes glued to sth｜stay glued to sb's side｜be glued to the spot
advancedExpressions.example: Eyes glued to the screen, he stayed glued to his seat, glued to the spot even as friends called his name. 目不转睛盯着屏幕，他黏在座位上，连朋友喊他都呆立不动。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「盯着/沉迷」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: be glued to sth ≈ can't take one's eyes off sth ≈ be fixed / focused on sth ≈ be absorbed in sth

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·分词/独立主格作状语
advancedExpressions.expression: Eyes glued to sth, sb. did ...（名词+过去分词的独立主格，作状语）
advancedExpressions.example: Eyes glued to his phone, he stepped into the road. 眼睛盯着手机，他走上了马路。（对应课文场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: eyes glued to ..., sb. failed to notice ...
advancedExpressions.example: Eyes glued to the tiny screen, he failed to notice the old man beside him struggling with his heavy bags, nor the disappointed look that crossed the stranger's face. （视线固定+错过现实的反差，续写伏笔）

advancedExpressions.expression: it has become a common sight to see sb. glued to ...
advancedExpressions.example: It has become an all-too-common sight to see families sitting together yet glued to separate screens, present in body but absent in heart. （倡议书点明现象，present in body but absent in heart 对仗）

advancedExpressions.expression: when sb. is forever glued to ..., sb. risks losing ...

sentenceUpgrade.original: He looked at his phone all the time and did not notice anything.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Head bowed and eyes glued to the little glowing screen, he drifted through the crowded street like a sleepwalker — deaf to the laughter, blind to the blossoms, oblivious to the very world that streamed unnoticed past his feet. （读后续写·环境+心理描写）

original_sentence: I always asked for Wi-Fi connections when I went to a new restaurant or coffee shop.
readingExamples: I always asked for Wi-Fi connections when I went to a new restaurant or coffee shop.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a system that uses radio waves to connect computers, phones and other devices to the internet without wires
(2) n. a wireless network connection available in a particular place, such as a home, café or airport

posExamples.sentence: The moment the storm knocked out the Wi-Fi, the whole family looked up from their screens, blinked at one another, and — for the first time in months — began to actually talk. （读后续写·断网重聚）
To help students focus during study hours, I would like to suggest that the school switch off the dormitory Wi-Fi from ten o'clock each night. （应用文·建议信）
Free public Wi-Fi has undeniably made our lives more convenient, yet it also tempts us to stay online every waking minute, at the quiet cost of our concentration and peace of mind. （议论文·科技双刃剑）

wordForms.noun: Wi-Fi（无线网络，专有名词，源自 Wireless Fidelity）
wordForms.other: 专有名词，首字母大写并带连字符 Wi-Fi;不可数名词，作'网络连接'讲有时可数(a Wi-Fi connection)。近义 wireless network / the internet。

collocations.translation: 无线网络连接（课文原句）
collocations.example: I always asked for Wi-Fi connections when I went to a new restaurant or coffee shop. 每到一家新餐馆或咖啡店，我总要问有没有无线网络连接。
