With only a weak Wi-Fi signal in the old classroom, the online lesson kept freezing, testing everyone's patience. （应用文·情况反映）
'The Wi-Fi password?' the waiter smiled. 'It's on the wall — but honestly, the view outside is worth logging off for.' （读后续写·对话）

synonyms.example: The library installed a fast wireless network so that students could look up references from any seat in the hall. （应用文·设施介绍）
synonyms.usage: 较正式、书面的说法，Wi-Fi 是其常见口语和日常称呼；正式通知、报告中可用 wireless network，日常表达用 Wi-Fi 更自然。

synonyms.example: A stable internet connection turned out to be the one thing the remote village school needed most. （议论文·教育公平）
synonyms.usage: 范围更广，泛指一切上网连接（含有线、移动数据），不特指无线；Wi-Fi 特指近距离无线接入。

advancedExpressions.expression: ask for / connect to the Wi-Fi｜a Wi-Fi connection / signal / password｜free public Wi-Fi｜the Wi-Fi is down
advancedExpressions.example: I asked for the Wi-Fi password and connected to the free Wi-Fi, but the signal was so weak the page never loaded. 我要了Wi-Fi密码连上免费网络，可信号太弱，页面始终没打开。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「无线网络」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: Wi-Fi ≈ a wireless network ≈ a wireless (internet) connection
advancedExpressions.example: The café offers free Wi-Fi / a free wireless network for its customers. 这家咖啡店为顾客提供免费无线网络。

advancedExpressions.expression: the moment the Wi-Fi died, ...
advancedExpressions.example: The moment the Wi-Fi died, a strange thing happened: the silence that everyone had dreaded slowly turned into the warmest evening the family had shared in years. （断网转折，续写以'失去'引出'获得'）

advancedExpressions.expression: I would suggest limiting Wi-Fi access to ... so that ...
advancedExpressions.example: I would suggest limiting dormitory Wi-Fi access to certain hours so that students may enjoy uninterrupted sleep and undivided focus. （建议信句式，so that 引出目的）

advancedExpressions.expression: Wi-Fi has liberated us and imprisoned us in equal measure
advancedExpressions.example: In truth, Wi-Fi has liberated us and imprisoned us in equal measure — granting the whole world at our fingertips while quietly stealing the world right in front of us. （对偶+对比，辩证论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: There was no Wi-Fi, so we talked to each other.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Stripped of Wi-Fi by the sudden blackout, we had nothing left to hide behind — and so, awkwardly at first and then with growing warmth, we began to talk, really talk, in a way we had somehow forgotten how to do. （读后续写·情感转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词状语(Stripped of Wi-Fi) + 破折号补充 + awkwardly...then with warmth 副词递进 + really talk 重复强调

sentenceUpgrade.original: Free Wi-Fi is convenient but makes people always online.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: While free Wi-Fi has woven convenience into the very fabric of daily life, it has also chained countless people to a screen from dawn to dusk, so that they are always connected to the network yet increasingly disconnected from one another. （议论文·双刃剑）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: While 让步状语从句 + woven...into the fabric 隐喻 + connected...yet disconnected 词根对比制造反讽

classPractice.question: 每到一家新咖啡店，我总会问有没有无线网络。Whenever I went to a new coffee shop, I always asked for ____ ____ (无线网络连接).
classPractice.note: 呼应课文;Wi-Fi 为专有名词大写带连字符，'连接'义可数。

classPractice.question: 用 connect / signal / password / free 填空:The library offers ____ Wi-Fi; just get the ____ from the front desk and ____ to it, though the ____ is weak upstairs.
classPractice.note: free Wi-Fi 免费网络;connect to the Wi-Fi;Wi-Fi password / signal 固定搭配。

original_sentence: A dead battery in my smartphone would make me feel stressed.
readingExamples: A dead battery in my smartphone would make me feel stressed.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a device that produces electricity to provide power for radios, cars, phones and other equipment
(2) n. a group of similar things, especially a large number of them arranged or used together
(3) n. (law) the crime of attacking someone physically

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 一系列，一大批（同类事物，a battery of sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: Before he could join the expedition, the young climber had to pass a battery of medical tests, each one stricter than the last. （读后续写·选拔考验）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （法律）殴打罪，人身侵犯（常 assault and battery）
uncommonMeanings.example: The old records revealed that the seemingly gentle landlord had once been charged with assault and battery — a secret the whole village had chosen to forget. （读后续写·悬疑伏笔）

posExamples.sentence: As the last bar of the battery blinked red, panic tightened its grip on her chest — the map, the address, her only lifeline in this unfamiliar city, was about to go dark. （读后续写·困境）
To reduce electronic waste, I would like to propose that our school set up special bins where students can safely dispose of used batteries. （应用文·倡议书）

The rapid development of battery technology lies at the very heart of the clean-energy revolution, for without cheaper and longer-lasting batteries, electric cars will never truly replace petrol ones. （议论文·科技与环保）
Halfway up the mountain his torch flickered and died; with a dead battery and the night closing in, he had no choice but to feel his way forward, one careful step at a time. （读后续写·历险）

wordForms.other: 复数 batteries;常见修饰 dead / flat / low / rechargeable。注意熟词僻义'一系列'(a battery of tests)和法律义'殴打罪'。

idioms.example: After a gruelling term, she went home to the quiet countryside to recharge her batteries, letting the birdsong and fresh air slowly knit her back together. （读后续写·休整）

collocations.example: A dead battery in my smartphone would make me feel stressed. 手机没电会让我感到焦虑。

collocations.translation: 【课件】没电的电池（= a dead battery）
collocations.example: The car wouldn't start because of a flat battery. 车因为电瓶没电发动不起来。
Battery failure left the phone dead all afternoon. 电池故障使手机整个下午都没电。
After a stressful week, I went home to recharge my batteries. 忙碌一周后，我回家养精蓄锐。
He plugged in his phone to recharge the battery. 他插上手机给电池充电。

collocations.translation: 一系列，一大批（同类事物，如测试/问题）
collocations.example: The candidate faced a battery of tough questions. 应聘者面对一连串刁钻的问题。
A dead battery in the middle of nowhere forced the two brothers to abandon the car and set off on foot, their adventure only just beginning. （读后续写·转折）
Just as she reached the thrilling final page of the e-book, the battery ran out, leaving the story — and her heart — hanging in mid-air. （读后续写·意外）
With a low battery and no charger in sight, he switched off every unnecessary app, hoarding each percent like a traveller rationing water in a desert. （读后续写·比喻）
Switching to rechargeable batteries is a small change, yet across a whole school it can spare the environment a mountain of toxic waste. （应用文·环保建议）
The new laptop boasted a battery life of fifteen hours, enough to carry her through an entire day of revision without once hunting for a socket. （应用文·产品介绍）
The little radio ran on batteries, and through the long power cut it became the family's only window to the outside world. （读后续写·困境中的温情）
The interview began gently enough, but soon the panel unleashed a battery of questions that left even the most confident candidate reaching for words. （读后续写·面试）

synonyms.example: The engineer explained that each solar cell converts sunlight directly into electricity, needing no fuel at all. （议论文·新能源）
synonyms.usage: 指单个电池单元或电芯，是构成 battery 的基本单位；battery 通常指成组的电池或整块电池，日常'电池'多用 battery。

synonyms.example: A sudden failure of the power supply plunged the whole laboratory into darkness moments before the crucial experiment. （读后续写·突发）
synonyms.usage: 泛指供电系统或电源装置，范围比 battery 广，可指电网、发电机等；battery 特指便携式储电装置。

synonyms.translation: 一大批，一系列（=battery 的'一系列'义）
synonyms.example: The museum displayed a dazzling array of ancient artefacts, each telling its own silent story of the past. （应用文·参观介绍）
synonyms.usage: 作'一大批、一系列'讲时与 battery of 近义，但 array 更强调'排列陈列、种类丰富'，battery of 更强调'接连不断地施加'（如 a battery of tests）。

advancedExpressions.expression: a dead / flat / low battery｜charge / recharge a battery｜the battery runs out / dies｜battery life｜run on batteries
advancedExpressions.example: With a low battery and no charger, he watched the battery die, wishing he had charged it earlier. 电量低又没充电器，他眼看电池耗尽，后悔没早点充电。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「电用完了」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: the battery is dead / flat ≈ the battery runs out / dies ≈ run out of power ≈ the phone goes flat
advancedExpressions.example: My phone's battery is dead / has run out. 我手机没电了。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·熟词僻义 a battery of
advancedExpressions.expression: a battery of + 复数名词 = 一系列、一大批（tests / questions / checks）
advancedExpressions.example: The astronauts underwent a battery of physical tests. 宇航员接受了一系列体检。

advancedExpressions.expression: with the battery down to its last ..., sb. ...
advancedExpressions.example: With the battery down to its last flickering bar, she typed the message with trembling fingers, praying it would fly out before the screen went black forever. （细节倒计时+心理，营造紧迫感）

advancedExpressions.expression: small acts such as recycling batteries can ...
advancedExpressions.example: Small acts such as recycling used batteries and switching off idle devices can, when multiplied across every household, make a world of difference. （倡议书以小见大，when multiplied 状语强化）

advancedExpressions.expression: the future of ... hinges on the humble battery
advancedExpressions.example: In many ways, the future of green transport hinges on the humble battery: master its storage and cost, and the age of clean energy will finally dawn. （hinges on 关键论点 + 冒号引出条件推论）

sentenceUpgrade.original: My phone's battery died and I felt worried.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: When the last sliver of battery vanished and the screen sank into darkness, a wave of helplessness washed over me — cut off from maps, from messages, from the whole glowing world I had come to lean on, I suddenly felt utterly, frighteningly alone. （读后续写·心理描写）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 时间状语从句渲染 + a wave of ... washed over 心理隐喻 + from...from...from 三项排比 + utterly, frighteningly alone 副词叠加强化孤独

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should recycle old batteries to protect the environment.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is high time that every one of us took responsibility for the used batteries we so carelessly discard, for these small silver capsules, if buried in the earth, leak poisons that will haunt our soil and water for generations to come. （应用文·倡议书）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is high time that + 过去式虚拟语气 + these small silver capsules 形象指代 + haunt our soil and water 拟人化后果 + for generations to come 时间纵深

classPractice.question: 手机没电会让我感到焦虑。____ ____ ____ (一块没电的电池) in my smartphone would make me feel stressed.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文;dead / flat battery 表'没电的电池'。

classPractice.question: 选词填空:Before the mission, the pilots had to pass a ____ (battery / group) of strict physical tests.
classPractice.note: 熟词僻义:a battery of sth 表'一连串、一大批'，比 group 更强调接连不断地施加。

classPractice.question: 用 recharge 补全习语:After a stressful week, I need a quiet weekend to ____ my ____.
classPractice.note: 习语 recharge one's batteries 养精蓄锐、恢复精力，此处为比喻用法。

translation: (quit, quit; quitted, quitted) 停止，戒掉；离开
original_sentence: Sliding into the habit was easy, but it was difficult to quit the habit.
readingExamples: Sliding into the habit was easy, but it was difficult to quit the habit.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. & vi. to stop doing something, especially a habit
(2) vt. & vi. to leave a job, school or activity, especially permanently
(3) vt. & vi. to leave a place
(4) vt. (computing) to close a program or application on a computer

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 离开（工作、学校、地方），辞去（职位）
uncommonMeanings.example: He quit his well-paid job to teach in a mountain village. 他辞去高薪工作去山村教书。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 离开某地
uncommonMeanings.example: They were ordered to quit the building at once. 他们被勒令立即离开这栋楼。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （计算机）退出、关闭（程序）
uncommonMeanings.example: Only after he had quit every app and shut the laptop with a soft click did the room fall into a silence he had almost forgotten how to enjoy. （读后续写·自律·关机静心）

posExamples.sentence: The night he finally decided to quit gaming, he stacked every disc in a box, sealed it with tape, and carried it to the attic — burying an old self so that a new one might rise. （读后续写·下定决心）
I am writing to urge every classmate never to quit halfway through our tree-planting project, for the greenest results always reward those who persist to the very end. （应用文·倡议书）
Those who quit at the first sign of hardship rarely discover what they are truly capable of, for success, more often than not, hides just beyond the point where most people give up. （议论文·坚持与放弃）
'You can't quit now — not when we're this close,' she whispered, tightening her grip on his frozen hand as the summit loomed through the swirling snow. （读后续写·对话·激励）

wordForms.noun: quitter（轻易放弃的人，半途而废者）
wordForms.other: 过去式/过去分词 quit-quit-quit（美式常用，本课采用），英式亦作 quitted。quit 后接动名词:quit doing sth（不接不定式）。

idioms.translation: 见好就收，趁占优势时收手
idioms.example: His coach laid a firm hand on his shoulder: 'You've proved your point today — sometimes the wisest thing is to quit while you're ahead.' （读后续写·师徒对话）

idioms.translation: 就此罢手，一笔勾销；喊停
idioms.example: After hours of fruitless arguing, the two old friends finally decided to call it quits and let the years of friendship outweigh a single foolish quarrel. （读后续写·和解）

collocations.translation: 【课件】停止；戒掉（尤指不好的或恼人的事）= give up
collocations.example: It was difficult to quit the habit. 戒掉这个习惯很难。
Sliding into the habit was easy, but it was difficult to quit the habit. 养成这习惯很容易，戒掉却很难。
He decided to quit drinking for the sake of his health. 为了健康，他决定戒酒。
She quit her job to travel around the world. 她辞职去环游世界。

collocations.translation: 【课件】离开这栋楼（quit 表'离开某地'）
collocations.example: They were ordered to quit the building at once. 他们被勒令立即离开这栋楼。

collocations.translation: 【课件】半途而废的人，遇到困难就放弃的人
collocations.example: He won't resign because he's not a quitter. 他不会辞职，因为他不是个轻言放弃的人。

collocations.translation: 戒烟／停止做某事（quit 后接动名词）
collocations.example: He promised to quit smoking for his children. 他答应为孩子戒烟。
Quitting the habit of late-night scrolling proved far harder than she had imagined, yet each phone-free night felt like a small, hard-won victory. （读后续写·自律）
Rather than let poverty force him to quit school, the whole village quietly pooled its savings to keep the bright boy at his desk. （读后续写·温情）
Champions are not those who never stumble, but those who refuse to quit halfway when the road grows steep. （议论文·成功论）
This time he was determined to quit for good, and he tore up the last packet so that no weak moment could ever tempt him again. （读后续写·决心）
After thirty glorious years, the veteran actor chose to quit the stage at his peak, bowing out to thunderous applause. （读后续写·谢幕）

synonyms.example: However dark the night grew, she refused to give up, clinging to the faint belief that dawn was hiding just beyond the ridge. （读后续写·励志）
synonyms.usage: 最常用、口语书面皆宜；'放弃努力'和'戒掉'两义都可，比 quit 略正式一点。表'戒掉习惯'时 give up 与 quit 通用，如 give up / quit smoking。

synonyms.translation: 抛弃，放弃（含'不负责任'意味）
synonyms.example: He could never abandon the stray dog that had followed him home through the rain, its trusting eyes fixed on his. （读后续写·善良）
synonyms.usage: 语气比 quit 重，强调'彻底舍弃、丢下不管'，常带贬义或情感色彩（抛弃人、职责、计划）；quit 更中性，多指停止习惯或离开岗位。

synonyms.example: Taking full responsibility for the failure, the manager chose to resign with dignity rather than shift the blame onto his team. （议论文／应用文·担当）
synonyms.usage: 特指'正式辞去职务'，书面、正式，常见于职场语境；quit one's job 更口语随意，resign 更庄重且强调'正式提出'。

advancedExpressions.expression: quit the habit｜quit doing sth（+动名词）｜quit one's job｜quit smoking｜quit school｜quit for good｜quit halfway
advancedExpressions.example: He decided to quit gaming for good, quit staying up late and quit halfway no more. 他决心彻底戒游戏，不再熬夜，也不再半途而废。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「戒掉/放弃」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: quit doing ≈ give up doing ≈ stop doing ≈ kick the habit of doing
advancedExpressions.example: He finally quit / gave up / stopped smoking. 他终于把烟戒了。

advancedExpressions.expression: quit doing sth（后接 -ing，不接 to do）
advancedExpressions.example: You should quit spending so much time on your phone. 你该少花时间在手机上。（不能说 quit to spend）

advancedExpressions.expression: no matter how ..., sb. would not quit
advancedExpressions.example: No matter how her legs screamed or her lungs burned, she would not quit — not with the finish line finally rising, blurred and beautiful, out of the distance. （倒装让步+破折号补充，续写高潮段展现顽强）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us press on and never quit until ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us press on and never quit until every corner of our campus is green, for a goal worth pursuing is worth pursuing to the very end. （倡议书号召，until 引出坚持的终点）

advancedExpressions.expression: the difference between success and failure often lies in whether one quits
advancedExpressions.example: The difference between the achiever and the also-ran often lies in a single choice: whether, at the darkest hour, one quits or holds on for one more try. （对比句式+冒号揭示核心论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was hard for him to quit the habit.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Quitting the habit felt like tearing off a part of himself: every idle minute begged for the familiar glow of the screen, and it took every ounce of will he possessed to keep his restless hand from reaching for it. （读后续写·心理挣扎）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动名词作主语 + like tearing off a part of himself 明喻 + begged 拟人 + every ounce of will 夸张强调戒断之难

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should not quit when things are difficult.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It would be a grave mistake to quit the moment the going gets tough, for history has shown, time and again, that the sweetest fruits of perseverance ripen only for those who have the courage to endure just a little longer. （议论文·坚持）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It would be a grave mistake to do 评价句式 + the moment 引导时间状语从句 + history has shown 权威论据 + the sweetest fruits...ripen 隐喻收尾

classPractice.question: It was difficult to quit ____ (scroll) through short videos late at night.
classPractice.note: quit 后接动名词 quit doing sth，不接不定式。

classPractice.question: 养成这个习惯很容易，但要戒掉它却很难。Sliding into the habit was easy, but it was difficult ____ ____ ____ ____ (戒掉这个习惯).
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句;此处 quit 作及物动词接名词宾语。

classPractice.question: 用 quit / resign / give up 各一次填空:Taking responsibility for the loss, the manager chose to ____ formally; the athlete decided to ____ smoking; and no one should ____ halfway.
classPractice.answer: resign; quit / give up; quit / give up
classPractice.note: resign 正式辞职;quit/give up smoking 戒烟;quit/give up halfway 半途而废。

original_sentence: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet!
readingExamples: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet!
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to move past someone or something very quickly, especially in a sudden rush
(2) phr. (of time) to seem to pass extremely fast
(3) phr. to travel or go past a point at high speed without stopping

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （指时间）飞逝，一晃而过
uncommonMeanings.example: I still remember how the school years seemed to shoot past. 我仍记得中学时光是如何飞逝而过的。

posExamples.sentence: Head down and eyes on his phone, he stepped off the kerb just as a delivery van shot past, its horn blasting, missing him by no more than a breath. （读后续写·险情）
I still remember how the school years seemed to shoot past — one moment we were nervous newcomers, and the next we stood at the gate, holding our diplomas and fighting back tears. （应用文·毕业感言）
When we bury ourselves in our screens, the truly precious moments of life shoot past unnoticed, and by the time we look up, they are already beyond our reach. （议论文·珍惜时光）
A silver blur shot past the finish line half a second before the rest, and only when the crowd erupted did she realize the runner in front was her own little brother. （读后续写·比赛惊喜）

wordForms.other: shoot 为不规则动词 shoot-shot-shot;此处 shoot 表'飞速移动'。同类 shoot 短语群:shoot up(猛涨/迅速长高)、shoot past(飞驰而过)、shoot ahead(冲到前面)、shoot for(争取)。

collocations.example: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past. 我低着头盯着手机走上马路，一辆车飞驰而过。

collocations.translation: 一辆车飞驰而过（课文原句）
collocations.example: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet! 我低着头，眼睛盯着手机，走上马路，一辆车飞驰而过，差点把我撞倒！

collocations.translation: 从某人／某物旁飞驰而过
collocations.example: A cyclist shot past me on the narrow path. 一名骑车人在窄道上从我身旁飞驰而过。
The three years of high school shot past like a dream. 高中三年像一场梦一样飞快过去了。
A car shot past so close that the rush of wind snatched the cap right off his head and sent it tumbling down the street. （读后续写·惊险）
With a final desperate burst, he shot past the finish line, collapsing onto the track as the roar of the crowd washed over him. （读后续写·冲刺）
The express train shot past at full speed, its windows a golden ribbon of light streaking through the darkness. （读后续写·夜景）

collocations.translation: 径直从某人／某物旁飞驰而过
collocations.example: So lost in thought was she that her own bus shot right past the stop before she even raised her head. （读后续写·走神）

synonyms.example: Cars whizzed past the terrified child, who stood frozen on the island in the middle of the roaring road. （读后续写·惊恐）
synonyms.usage: 口语、生动，常带'呼呼声'的画面感，多形容车辆、子弹等疾速掠过；与 shoot past 近义，whizz past 更突出'声音+速度'的双重感官冲击。

synonyms.example: A boy dashed past, chasing his runaway kite, laughter trailing behind him like a bright ribbon. （读后续写·童趣）
synonyms.usage: 多指人快速跑过，强调'奔跑'的动作；shoot past 更强调'突然、迅猛如射出'，可用于车、人、时间，范围更广。

synonyms.example: The summer holiday flew by, and before she knew it, the first crisp morning of autumn was tapping at her window. （读后续写·时光）
synonyms.usage: '时间飞逝'义与 shoot past 相近，fly by 更柔和、常用；形容实物疾驰时，shoot past 的冲击力和突然感更强。

advancedExpressions.expression: shoot past（飞驰而过）｜shoot up（猛涨/迅速长高）｜shoot ahead（冲到前面）｜shoot for / at（争取；瞄准）｜shoot down（击落；驳倒）
advancedExpressions.example: Prices shot up, the runner shot ahead, and a car shot past — everything seemed to move at once. 物价猛涨，选手冲到前面，一辆车飞驰而过——一切仿佛同时飞动起来。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「飞驰/飞逝」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: shoot past ≈ whizz past ≈ speed past ≈ fly by（时间）≈ dash past（人）
advancedExpressions.example: A car shot / whizzed / sped past. 一辆车飞驰而过。

advancedExpressions.expression: just as sb. ..., sth. shot past, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as he stepped into the road, a car shot past in a screech of tyres, so close that he could feel its heat on his cheek and taste the panic rising in his throat. （just as 时间同步+多感官细节，续写制造惊险）

advancedExpressions.expression: how quickly these years have shot past
advancedExpressions.example: Looking back, I am struck by how quickly these three years have shot past, and how much of who I am today was quietly shaped within these familiar walls. （毕业感言，how 感叹句式抒发不舍）

advancedExpressions.expression: life shoots past those who refuse to look up
advancedExpressions.example: Life, in all its fleeting beauty, shoots past those who refuse to look up from their screens, and no amount of regret can ever call a wasted moment back. （拟人+警句式收束，强化珍惜时间的论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A car went by very fast and almost hit me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Out of nowhere a car shot past in a deafening blur, its side mirror grazing my sleeve, and for one frozen heartbeat the whole world narrowed to the pounding of my own terrified pulse. （读后续写·惊险瞬间）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Out of nowhere 突发状语 + in a deafening blur 感官描写 + grazing my sleeve 细节 + for one frozen heartbeat 时间凝滞 + the world narrowed to 心理聚焦

sentenceUpgrade.original: Time passes quickly when we waste it on our phones.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The hours we surrender to that glowing screen shoot past like water through open fingers — silent, unstoppable, and gone before we ever think to hold them, until one day we look up to find that whole seasons of our lives have slipped away. （议论文·惜时）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: like water through open fingers 明喻 + silent, unstoppable, gone 三形容词递进 + until one day 时间转折 + whole seasons of our lives 以季节喻光阴

classPractice.question: I stepped into the road and a car ____ (shoot) past, nearly knocking me off my feet.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文;shoot 为不规则动词，过去式 shot;此处叙述过去发生的事。

classPractice.question: 用 shoot 短语填空(past / up / ahead):Prices ____; the front runner ____; and a van ____ so fast it splashed mud on us.
classPractice.answer: shot up; shot ahead; shot past
classPractice.note: shoot up 猛涨;shoot ahead 冲到前面;shoot past 飞驰而过。

classPractice.question: 低着头盯着手机，我一走上马路就有辆车飞驰而过。Head down, eyes on my phone, I stepped into the road and a car ____ ____, nearly knocking me off my feet.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文场景;shoot past 飞驰而过，注意过去式 shot。

translation: 撞倒某人，使某人双脚离地
original_sentence: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet!
readingExamples: Head down, eyes on my smartphone, I stepped into the road and a car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet!
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to hit or push someone so hard that they fall to the ground
(2) phr. to impress or overwhelm someone so much that they are momentarily stunned or lose their composure
(3) phr. (of a sudden emotion, wave, or force) to physically or emotionally sweep someone away

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】使人倾倒、印象深刻、极度兴奋（比喻，to thoroughly impress, overwhelm or excite one）
uncommonMeanings.example: The final 30 minutes of the film completely knocked me off my feet. 这部电影最后30分钟让我彻底倾倒。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 使某人震惊、深深打动（比喻，非字面撞倒）
uncommonMeanings.example: When the shy new student finished her monologue, the sheer power of her voice knocked the entire audition panel off their feet — for a full three seconds, nobody could speak. （读后续写·才艺震撼场景）

posExamples.sentence: Head down and lost in thought, I never saw the cyclist coming; in a blur of metal and shouting he swerved and clipped my shoulder, nearly knocking me off my feet on the crowded crossing. （读后续写·街头惊险瞬间）
I am writing to warn fellow students that the newly waxed corridor is dangerously slippery, and last week a rushing classmate was knocked off his feet and sprained his wrist. （应用文·安全提醒/投诉信）
A single piece of unexpected news can knock even the most confident person off their feet, which is precisely why emotional resilience deserves a place in every school curriculum. （议论文·心理健康主题）
The moment the roaring wave crashed over the pier, it knocked several onlookers off their feet, and screams mingled with the thunder of the sea. （读后续写·自然灾难/海边场景）

wordForms.other: 固定习语:knock sb off one's/his/her feet;其中 one's 需与 sb 保持一致(knock me off my feet)。近义 knock sb down;比喻义'令人震惊'近 sweep/bowl sb off their feet。

idioms.translation: 把某人撞倒／使某人站不稳；使某人大为震惊（习语，课文）
idioms.example: A car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet! （课文原句，习语出处）

idioms.translation: 使某人倾心；令某人神魂颠倒（多指恋爱）
idioms.example: From the very first dance, his effortless grace swept her off her feet, and the noisy hall seemed to dissolve into a single, spinning moment. （读后续写·情感萌动）
Trembling but determined, the old veteran struggled to his feet and, against all expectation, began to sing the anthem alone. （读后续写·人物意志）

collocations.translation: 【课件】把某人撞翻在地；（比喻）让人倾倒、极度兴奋、印象深刻
collocations.example: The final 30 minutes of the film completely knocked me off my feet. 这部电影最后30分钟让我彻底倾倒／印象极深。
A branch fell and knocked his hat off. 一根树枝掉下来把他的帽子打落了。

collocations.phrase: nearly knock sb off one's feet
collocations.translation: 差点把某人撞倒（课文原句）
collocations.example: A car shot past, nearly knocking me off my feet! 一辆车飞驰而过，差点把我撞倒！

collocations.phrase: be knocked off one's feet by sth
collocations.example: He was knocked off his feet by the force of the blast. 他被爆炸的冲击力掀翻在地。

collocations.phrase: knock sb off one's feet with joy / shock
collocations.translation: 使某人因狂喜/震惊而站不稳
collocations.example: The acceptance letter knocked her off her feet with joy; she read it three times before daring to believe it was real. （读后续写·喜讯降临）

collocations.phrase: a car / wave / crowd knocks sb off one's feet
collocations.example: In the surging crowd at the concert exit, a stumbling stranger almost knocked me off my feet, and only a firm hand on my arm kept me upright. （读后续写·人群拥挤）

collocations.phrase: knock sb flat off one's feet
collocations.example: The charging dog knocked the little boy flat off his feet, but instead of crying, he burst into delighted laughter. （读后续写·温馨童趣）
The explosion sent bystanders off their feet, and a stunned silence hung over the square before the sirens began. （读后续写·突发事件）

collocations.phrase: knock sth over / knock sb down
collocations.example: In his haste to catch the bus, he knocked over a fruit stall and, mortified, stopped to help the vendor gather the rolling apples. （读后续写·善意行为）

synonyms.example: The speeding scooter knocked an elderly man down at the zebra crossing, and a dozen passers-by rushed to help him up. （读后续写·街头事故）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:knock sb down 强调把人撞倒在地、常伴受伤，语气更直接、更常见；knock sb off one's feet 更强调'双脚离地、失去平衡'这一瞬间画面，也可作比喻'震撼'。

synonyms.translation: 撞翻某人；使某人大为震惊
synonyms.example: The revelation of her true identity bowled everyone over — jaws dropped and the room fell utterly silent. （读后续写·真相揭露）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:bowl sb over 字面'撞翻'，但更常用于比喻'令人惊叹、折服'，情感冲击色彩最浓，适合续写高潮。

synonyms.example: A hidden tree root tripped the runner up just meters from the finish line, yet she scrambled back to her feet undaunted. （读后续写·比赛逆境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:trip sb up 强调'被绊而跌'，起因是脚下障碍而非外力冲撞，也可比喻'使人犯错、露馅'。

advancedExpressions.expression: knock sb off one's feet（撞倒/震撼）｜sweep sb off one's feet（使倾心）｜be run off one's feet（忙得团团转）｜rise to one's feet（站起身）
advancedExpressions.example: The blast knocked him off his feet; the news later swept the crowd off their feet. 爆炸把他掀翻在地;那消息随后让人群大为震撼。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「撞倒/震撼」（可替换）
advancedExpressions.expression: knock sb off one's feet ≈ knock sb down（撞倒）≈ bowl sb over / knock sb sideways（震撼）
advancedExpressions.example: The speeding bike almost knocked me off my feet / knocked me down. 那辆飞车差点把我撞倒。

advancedExpressions.expression: knock + sb + off + one's feet（one's 随宾语人称变化:me→my, him→his, us→our）
advancedExpressions.example: The wave knocked us off our feet. 海浪把我们掀翻在地。（不能说 off our feet 之外的错配）

advancedExpressions.expression: so + adj. + that it nearly knocked sb off one's feet
advancedExpressions.example: The impact was so sudden that it nearly knocked me off my feet, and for one dizzying instant the world tilted sideways. （so...that结果状语从句 + 瞬间眩晕感官描写，营造惊险画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: the news / sight / sound knocked sb off one's feet
advancedExpressions.example: The sight of her name at the top of the list knocked her clean off her feet; she gripped the notice board, heart hammering against her ribs. （比喻用法 + 心跳生理反应，把'震撼'具象化）

advancedExpressions.expression: just as a sudden blow can knock a person off their feet, ..., so too ...
advancedExpressions.example: Just as a sudden blow can knock a person off their feet, an unexpected failure can shatter one's confidence — so too must we cultivate the inner steadiness to rise again. （类比论证 so too 倒装，将具体动作升华为抽象哲理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: A car nearly hit me.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Head down and eyes glued to my phone, I stepped blindly into the road just as a car shot past in a screaming blur, its wing mirror grazing my sleeve and nearly knocking me off my feet. （读后续写·惊险瞬间）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 过去分词短语作状语(Head down)营造画面 + just as 同时性引出突发 + 感官细节(screaming blur, grazing my sleeve) + 短语 knock sb off one's feet 收尾

sentenceUpgrade.original: The good news surprised us all.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is no exaggeration to say that the announcement all but knocked us off our feet, leaving the entire office in a stunned, disbelieving hush before the cheers finally erupted. （应用文/记叙·情绪渲染）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is no exaggeration to say that...强调框架 + all but(几乎)程度副词 + 现在分词短语(leaving...)描摹群体反应 + before引出情绪转折

classPractice.question: 一辆车飞驰而过，差点把我撞倒。A car shot past, nearly ____ me ____ ____ ____ (把我撞倒).
classPractice.note: 呼应课文;knock sb off one's feet，one's 需与宾语 me 一致，用 my。

classPractice.question: The huge wave knocked several onlookers off ____ (they) feet.
classPractice.note: 物主代词须与宾语 onlookers 一致，用 their feet。

classPractice.question: 选词填空(knocked off her feet / swept off her feet):The stunning result of the exam ____ ____ ____ ____ ____ with joy.
classPractice.note: 比喻'震惊'用 knock sb off one's feet;sweep sb off one's feet 侧重'使倾心/恋爱'，语境不符。

original_sentence: It was scary at first.
readingExamples: It was scary at first.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. frightening; causing fear or alarm
(2) adj. (informal) worrying or difficult to deal with because of uncertainty
(3) adj. (of a place, story, or experience) intended or likely to make you feel afraid

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （非正式）因不确定而令人担忧的、难以应付的
uncommonMeanings.example: It's a bit scary not knowing what the future holds. 不知未来会怎样，这有点令人不安。

posExamples.sentence: The corridor stretched ahead of me, dark and silent, and every creak of the old floorboards sounded scary enough to make my heart leap into my throat. （读后续写·夜探老宅）
I have to admit that standing before three hundred strangers was a scary prospect, yet the warm applause afterwards made every trembling second worthwhile. （应用文·演讲经历分享）
It may seem scary to step outside our comfort zone, but it is precisely in those uncertain, uncomfortable moments that genuine growth takes root. （议论文·成长主题）
Learning to ride without training wheels felt scary at first, yet the moment I found my balance, fear melted into pure, exhilarating freedom. （读后续写·克服恐惧）

wordForms.adjective: scary（吓人的，主动令人怕） / scared（害怕的，人感到怕） / scaring（正令人害怕的）
wordForms.other: 关键辨析:scary/scaring 修饰引起恐惧的事物(a scary film);scared 修饰感到害怕的人(be scared of dogs)。动词短语 scare sb away / off 把某人吓跑。

collocations.translation: 起初令人害怕（课文原句）
collocations.example: It was scary at first. 起初这挺吓人的。
Getting lost in the fog was the scariest experience of my life. 在雾中迷路是我一生中最可怕的经历。

collocations.translation: 看起来／听起来／感觉可怕
collocations.example: The thunderstorm sounded scary from inside the tent. 从帐篷里听，雷暴声很吓人。
We huddled together under one blanket, laughing nervously as the scary movie built towards its inevitable jump-scare. （读后续写·朋友聚会）
The prospect of facing the interview panel alone was scary, yet I reminded myself that courage is not the absence of fear. （议论文/记叙·心理独白）

collocations.translation: 十足可怕的／着实吓人的
collocations.example: The abandoned factory, with its shattered windows and echoing halls, was downright scary even in broad daylight. （读后续写·探险场景）
The rickety rope bridge swaying over the gorge was seriously scary, but crossing it left me buzzing with triumph. （读后续写·挑战自我）

synonyms.example: The frightening howl of the wind tore through the night, and the children pulled their blankets tighter. （读后续写·风雨之夜）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:frightening 比 scary 更正式、更书面，程度也更强，适合议论文和正式记叙；scary 偏口语，日常和轻松语境更自然。

synonyms.translation: 极其恐怖的，令人惊骇的
synonyms.example: The terrifying roar of the collapsing bridge sent everyone sprinting for the riverbank. （读后续写·灾难场景）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:terrifying 程度最强，表'吓得魂飞魄散'，用于生死攸关或极端场景；scary 程度较轻，可指'刺激但不致命'的害怕。

synonyms.translation: 阴森的，令人毛骨悚然的
synonyms.example: There was something creepy about the way the doll's eyes seemed to follow us around the dusty attic. （读后续写·悬疑氛围）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:creepy 侧重'诡异、令人起鸡皮疙瘩'的不安，强调氛围而非直接的惊吓，适合营造悬疑气氛。

synonyms.example: The alarming rate at which the floodwater rose forced the villagers to evacuate before dawn. （议论文/新闻·警示语境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:alarming 侧重'令人警觉、担忧'，多用于数据、趋势、局势，理性色彩强；scary 更主观、更情绪化。

advancedExpressions.expression: scary at first｜feel / look / sound scary｜be scared of sth｜scare sb away / off｜give sb a scare
advancedExpressions.example: The dark cave looked scary and I felt scared, but nothing there could really scare me away. 黑暗的洞穴看着吓人，我也害怕，但里面没什么真能把我吓跑。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「可怕的」（可替换，程度递进）
advancedExpressions.expression: scary（口语）< frightening（较正式）< terrifying（极度恐怖）;creepy（阴森诡异）;alarming（令人担忧）
advancedExpressions.example: The story was scary / frightening / downright terrifying. 这故事吓人／令人恐惧／简直骇人。

advancedExpressions.expression: scare(v.) → scary(adj.物令人怕) / scared(adj.人感到怕) / scarily(adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: The scary noise scared the scared child even more. 那吓人的声音把本已害怕的孩子吓得更厉害。

advancedExpressions.expression: there was something scary about the way ...
advancedExpressions.example: There was something scary about the way the shadows lengthened and the birds fell silent all at once, as if the forest itself were holding its breath. （there was something...about结构 + 拟人'holding its breath'渲染诡异气氛）

advancedExpressions.expression: scary as it was, ...
advancedExpressions.example: Scary as it was to let go of the railing, I forced my trembling fingers open and, for one weightless heartbeat, I was flying. （as让步倒装 + 生理细节 trembling fingers + 瞬间感受 weightless，写恐惧转化为勇气）

advancedExpressions.expression: what seems scary is often what shapes us most
advancedExpressions.example: What seems scary is often what shapes us most: it is by confronting, rather than avoiding, our fears that we forge genuine resilience. （主语从句 + 冒号解释 + it is...that强调，将'可怕'升华为成长契机）

sentenceUpgrade.original: It was scary at first.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Scary as it was at first — my palms sweating, my heart pounding against my ribs — the fear slowly loosened its grip the moment I dared to take that first step. （读后续写·心理转变）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as让步倒装(Scary as it was) + 破折号插入生理细节(palms sweating, heart pounding) + 拟人 fear loosened its grip 写恐惧消退

sentenceUpgrade.original: The dark house was scary.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The old house loomed against the moonless sky, its broken windows gaping like hollow eyes, and a scary stillness pressed in from every corner as I crept up the creaking stairs. （读后续写·恐怖氛围）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 动词 loomed 营造压迫感 + 明喻 like hollow eyes + 通感 scary stillness pressed in + 现在分词 creaking 补声音细节

classPractice.question: 选词填空(scary / scared):The dark forest looked ____, and every strange sound left the children ____.
classPractice.note: scary 修饰引起恐惧的事物;scared 修饰感到害怕的人。

classPractice.question: 起初这挺吓人的，但我慢慢开始感到自由。It was ____ ____ ____ (起初挺吓人的), but then somehow I began to feel free.
classPractice.note: 呼应课文原句 It was scary at first;scary at first 固定表达。

classPractice.question: ____ (scare) as it was to speak before three hundred strangers, I forced myself to walk onto the stage.
classPractice.note: as 引导让步倒装 Adj. + as it was;此处用形容词 scary 修饰情形'令人害怕'。

translation: 不知怎么地；以某种方式（或方法）
original_sentence: Then somehow I began to feel free.
readingExamples: Then somehow I began to feel free.
definitionEn:
(1) adv. in some way, or by some means, though you do not know how
(2) adv. for a reason that is not clear or that you cannot explain
(3) adv. used to say that you will do something even though it seems difficult

posExamples.sentence: The storm had knocked out the power and torn the tent to shreds, yet somehow we made it through the night, huddled together and laughing at our own misfortune. （读后续写·逆境求生）
I promise that, however tight the budget may be, we will somehow raise enough funds to send every child in the shelter a warm winter coat. （应用文·倡议/募捐信）
Somehow, the students who fail the most often turn out to be the ones who succeed the most spectacularly — a paradox that reveals the true value of perseverance. （议论文·失败与成功）
Then somehow, standing alone on that empty road with only birdsong for company, I began to feel a lightness I had not known in years. （读后续写·心境转变）

wordForms.other: someway (非标准/口语变体), somehow or other (强调)

idioms.translation: 不知怎么地；总之设法（强调）
idioms.example: Somehow or other, the little dog always found its way home, no matter how far it wandered. （读后续写·忠犬归途）
We had no map and no signal, but somehow or another we stumbled onto the right trail just as the sun dipped below the ridge. （读后续写·迷路脱险）

collocations.phrase: somehow = for a reason that is unknown（不知为何）
collocations.translation: 【课件】不知为何，莫名其妙地（表原因不明）
collocations.example: Somehow, he looked strange. 不知为何，他看上去很奇怪。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: somehow = in some ways（以某种方式）
collocations.translation: 【课件】以某种方式（或方法）；不知用什么办法
collocations.example: They may not take a direct path, but somehow they realized their dreams. 他们也许没走直路，但不知怎的还是实现了梦想。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 然后不知怎么地……开始……（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Then somehow I began to feel free. 然后不知怎么地，我开始感到自由。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 不知怎么地；总之设法（强调）
collocations.example: Somehow or other, he finished the report on time. 不知怎的，他还是按时完成了报告。

collocations.translation: 不知怎么地设法做成某事
collocations.example: She somehow managed to fix the old radio. 她不知怎么就把旧收音机修好了。
The house somehow felt colder that night. 那晚这房子莫名地更冷了。
I will somehow finish this race. 我无论如何都要跑完这场比赛。
We somehow ended up rescuing a stray kitten. 我们不知怎的最后救了一只流浪小猫。

collocations.translation: 莫名地知道 / 感觉到
collocations.example: She somehow sensed that something was wrong. 她莫名地感觉到有什么不对劲。
The shop somehow survived the hard winter. 这家小店总算熬过了这个严冬。

synonyms.example: In some way I could not quite name, that brief encounter changed the course of my entire summer. （读后续写·偶遇改变）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:in some way 更中性、更书面，纯指'方式不明'；somehow 除'方式不明'外还常带'费尽周折'或'莫名其妙'的情感色彩。

synonyms.example: For some reason, the melody drifting from the open window brought tears to my eyes. （读后续写·情感触动）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:for some reason 强调'原因不明'；somehow 可指'方式不明'也可指'原因不明'，语义更宽泛、更口语化。

synonyms.example: One way or another, we were determined to reach the summit before nightfall. （读后续写·登顶决心）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:one way or another 强调'不管用什么方法都要做成'的决心，语气更坚定；somehow 表决心时语气略弱、更随意。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·表示「方式/原因不明」(可替换somehow)
advancedExpressions.expression: somehow ≈ in some way / for some reason / one way or another
advancedExpressions.example: Somehow / In some way / For some reason, the plan worked out. 不知怎么地，这个计划成功了。（三者都可填入表'不知何故'，语气略有差别）

advancedExpressions.expression: somehow or other / somehow manage to do / will somehow do
advancedExpressions.example: Somehow or other we found our way back before dark. 总之我们赶在天黑前找到了回去的路。（'or other'加强'反正想尽办法'语气）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·somehow 作副词修饰全句
advancedExpressions.expression: Somehow, + 主句（句首作评注性状语，用逗号隔开）
advancedExpressions.example: Somehow, the students who fail most often succeed most. 不知怎的，最常失败的学生往往最成功。（somehow放句首软化断言）

advancedExpressions.expression: against all odds, somehow ...
advancedExpressions.example: Against all odds, somehow we clawed our way back from three goals down and snatched victory in the final seconds. （against all odds 让步短语 + somehow 强调'不可思议地做到'，渲染逆转的震撼）

advancedExpressions.expression: and then somehow ..., as if ...
advancedExpressions.example: And then somehow the knot in my chest began to loosen, as if a window had quietly been opened onto a brighter, kinder world. （then somehow 引出转折 + as if虚拟比喻，把抽象释然具象为'开窗'）

advancedExpressions.expression: somehow, it is often ... that ...
advancedExpressions.example: Somehow, it is often in our darkest, most desperate hours that we discover reserves of courage we never knew we possessed. （somehow软化断言 + it is...that强调句锁定核心，将现象升华为哲理）

sentenceUpgrade.original: Then somehow I began to feel free.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Then somehow, with the phone tucked away and my eyes lifted to the open sky for the first time in months, a quiet sense of freedom began to seep into my chest. （读后续写·心境释放）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: somehow 保留原句韵味 + with独立结构补背景(phone tucked away) + 通感动词 seep into 把抽象'自由'具象化 + 时间对比 for the first time in months

sentenceUpgrade.original: We finished the project on time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Despite the crashed computers and the sleepless nights, we somehow pulled the project together right on the deadline, proof that determination can bend even the most stubborn circumstances. （议论文/记叙·坚韧主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Despite让步状语铺陈困难 + somehow pulled together生动短语 + 同位语 proof that... 提炼道理，收束升华

classPractice.question: 写出句中 somehow 的含义（不知为何 / 以某种方式）：Somehow, he looked strange.
classPractice.answer: 不知为何（for a reason that is unknown）
classPractice.note: 课件例句；此处 somehow 表'原因不明、莫名其妙'

classPractice.question: 写出句中 somehow 的含义（不知为何 / 以某种方式）：They may not take a direct path, but somehow they realized their dreams.
classPractice.answer: 以某种方式（in some ways；不知用什么办法）
classPractice.note: 课件例句；此处 somehow 表'以某种方式/想尽办法'

classPractice.question: Then ____ I began to feel free, as if a heavy weight had suddenly been lifted from my shoulders.
classPractice.note: 课文原句语境；副词'不知怎么地'置于句首/句中修饰全句

classPractice.question: 无论多难，我们都要设法筹到足够的钱。However hard it is, we will ____ ____ enough money.
classPractice.note: somehow + 实义动词，表'想方设法'的决心

classPractice.question: 用 somehow / anyhow 填空：____ or other, the little dog always found its way home.
classPractice.note: 固定搭配 somehow or other '不知怎么地、总之设法'

original_sentence: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always wanted to read and was soon lost in the beautiful language.
readingExamples: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always wanted to read and was soon lost in the beautiful language.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. to be so absorbed in an activity or state that you are unaware of your surroundings
(2) phr. to be completely occupied by thought, emotion, or imagination
(3) phr. to be unable to find your way in (a place); to be surrounded and bewildered by something

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （信息、意义等）在……中丢失、被淹没
uncommonMeanings.example: So much of the poem's delicate beauty is lost in a hasty, word-for-word translation that misses the music between the lines. （议论文·翻译与文化，熟词僻义'被丢失/被淹没'）

posExamples.sentence: Curled up in the window seat with the rain drumming softly outside, I was soon lost in the beautiful language of the old novel, deaf to the world around me. （读后续写·沉浸阅读）
I would encourage every classmate to spend an hour each evening lost in a good book, for it is in those quiet pages that both knowledge and imagination flourish. （应用文·阅读倡议书）
Those who are perpetually lost in their smartphones risk missing the very richness of life — the laughter of friends, the beauty of a sunset, the small wonders that no screen can capture. （议论文·手机与生活）
For a long while she sat by the window, lost in thought, her fingers tracing the faded photograph as memories of that distant summer came flooding back. （读后续写·睹物思人）

idioms.translation: 陷入沉思，出神（高频习语）
idioms.example: So lost in thought was he that he did not hear the bell. 他出神到连铃声都没听见。（倒装强调）
So lost in thought was he that he did not hear the bell ring, nor notice the classroom slowly emptying around him. （读后续写·沉思出神，倒装强调）
As the music swelled, the dancers got lost in the moment, their movements flowing as naturally as a river. （读后续写·舞台沉醉）

collocations.example: I was soon lost in the beautiful language of the novel. 我很快便沉浸于小说优美的语言之中。（课件义）
For a long while she sat by the window, lost in thought. 她久久地坐在窗边，陷入沉思。（课件短语）另: She sat by the window, lost in thought. 她坐在窗边，陷入沉思。

collocations.translation: 【课件】重拾那本名著小说（pick up = to continue, to start again 重新开始/继续）
collocations.example: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always wanted to read. 我终于重拾那本一直想读的经典小说。（课件搭配，与 be lost in 同一语境）

collocations.phrase: be soon lost in the beautiful language
collocations.translation: 很快沉醉于优美的语言（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always wanted to read and was soon lost in the beautiful language. 我终于拿起那本我一直想读的经典小说，很快便沉醉于其优美的语言之中。（课文原句）

collocations.phrase: be lost in a book / novel
collocations.translation: 沉浸于一本书 / 小说中
collocations.example: On rainy days I love being lost in a good novel. 下雨天我喜欢沉浸在一本好小说里。
The old pianist was utterly lost in the music. 那位老钢琴家完全陶醉在音乐中。

collocations.phrase: be lost in memories / the past
collocations.translation: 沉浸在回忆 / 往事中
collocations.example: Grandma was lost in memories of her village. 奶奶沉浸在对家乡村庄的回忆里。

collocations.translation: 惊叹不已 / 满心钦佩
collocations.example: Beneath the waterfall the travellers were lost in wonder. 在瀑布下，游客们惊叹不已。

collocations.translation: 消失在人群中；淹没于人海
collocations.example: In a second he was lost in the crowd. 一转眼他就消失在人群中。

collocations.phrase: be lost in one's own world
collocations.example: The boy was lost in his own world of dinosaurs. 那男孩沉浸在自己的恐龙世界里。

synonyms.example: So absorbed in her painting was she that the paint dried on the brush before she noticed. （读后续写·专注创作）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be absorbed in 强调'注意力被完全吸引、投入'，偏理性专注，后接活动/工作；be lost in 更带'忘我、沉醉'的情感色彩，常用于阅读、回忆、音乐等审美体验。句法上二者均为'be + 过去分词 + in + 名词'。

synonyms.example: Fully immersed in the local culture, the exchange student soon spoke the dialect like a native. （应用文/记叙·文化浸润）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be immersed in 强调'长时间深度投入、浸泡'，常接学习、文化、工作，可用于持续状态；be lost in 更瞬时、更感性，强调'一时忘我'。

synonyms.example: The whole class sat engrossed in the experiment, scarcely daring to breathe as the liquid changed colour. （读后续写·课堂专注）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:be engrossed in 语气最正式、书面，强调'高度专注到旁若无人'；be lost in 更口语、更富诗意，尤宜续写抒情场景。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「沉浸/全神贯注」(可替换be lost in)
advancedExpressions.expression: be lost in ≈ be absorbed in / be immersed in / be engrossed in / be wrapped up in
advancedExpressions.example: She was lost in / absorbed in / immersed in / engrossed in the novel. 她全神贯注地读着那本小说。（四者都表'沉浸投入'，be lost in 最富'忘我沉醉'的情感色彩）

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·lose 相关沉浸/迷失表达
advancedExpressions.expression: be lost in thought / get lost in the moment / lose oneself in sth
advancedExpressions.example: He lost himself in the music and forgot the time. 他沉醉在音乐里，忘了时间。（lose oneself in = be lost in，均表沉浸）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·be lost in 中 lost 为过去分词作表语
advancedExpressions.expression: 主语 + be动词 + lost in + 名词（表状态）；作状语时可省be动词写作 lost in ...
advancedExpressions.example: For a while she sat by the window, lost in thought. 她在窗边坐了一会儿，陷入沉思。（lost in thought 作伴随状语，省略主语与be）

advancedExpressions.expression: so lost in ... was sb. that ...
advancedExpressions.example: So lost in the melody was she that she failed to notice the hall had fallen silent and every eye had turned towards her. （so...that倒装到句首 + failed to notice强化忘我，把'沉浸'写到极致）

advancedExpressions.expression: there is nothing quite like being lost in ...
advancedExpressions.example: There is nothing quite like being lost in a well-loved book on a quiet afternoon; I sincerely urge every classmate to rediscover this simple joy. （there is nothing quite like...最高级式推荐 + 倡议句式，凸显阅读之美）

advancedExpressions.expression: to be lost in ... is not to lose oneself, but to find ...
advancedExpressions.example: To be lost in a great work of art is not to lose oneself, but to find, in another's vision, a truer reflection of one's own soul. （不定式主语 + not...but...对照 + 哲理反转，将'迷失'升华为'寻获'）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I read the novel and forgot about time.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I finally picked up the classic novel I had always longed to read, and within minutes I was lost in its beautiful language, utterly deaf to the ticking clock and the fading afternoon light. （读后续写·沉浸阅读）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 定语从句(I had always longed to read)补渴望 + be lost in核心短语 + utterly deaf to夸张写忘我 + 环境细节(ticking clock, fading light)烘托时间流逝

sentenceUpgrade.original: Reading is a good habit that benefits us.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my firm belief that few habits enrich the mind so profoundly as the simple act of being lost in a good book, where knowledge, imagination and quiet joy converge. （议论文·阅读价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my firm belief that...观点框架 + few...so...as比较结构强调 + where定语从句 + 三名词并列(knowledge, imagination, joy)收束升华

classPractice.question: 她久久地坐在窗边，陷入沉思。For a long while she sat by the window, ____ ____ ____.
classPractice.note: 课件短语 be lost in thought '陷入沉思'；作状语时省略主语与 be，写作 lost in thought

classPractice.question: 我拿起那本经典小说，很快便沉浸于其优美的语言之中。I picked up the classic novel and was soon ____ ____ the beautiful language.
classPractice.note: 课文原句短语 be lost in '沉浸于'；was 后接过去分词 lost

classPractice.question: 把 She was completely absorbed in the book. 改写为含 lost 的同义句：She was completely ____ ____ the book.
classPractice.note: be absorbed in ≈ be lost in，均表'全神贯注/沉浸'

classPractice.question: So ____ (lose) in thought was he that he did not hear the bell ring.
classPractice.note: so...that 倒装；lost 为过去分词作表语，构成 be lost in thought

original_sentence: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities to see how much progress I was making.
readingExamples: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities to see how much progress I was making.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a written record in which you regularly note down your experiences, thoughts, and feelings; a diary
(2) n. a serious magazine or newspaper, especially one that deals with a specialist or academic subject
(3) n. a daily record of business transactions or official proceedings

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】期刊，杂志（区别于'日记'义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her research was finally published in a leading scientific journal. 她的研究终于发表在一份顶尖的科学期刊上。（课件义'期刊'）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （学术）期刊，杂志（高考常考，区别于日记义）
uncommonMeanings.example: Her groundbreaking research was finally published in a leading scientific journal, earning her the recognition she had long deserved. （议论文/记叙·学术成就，熟词僻义'期刊'）

posExamples.sentence: Every night before bed, I opened my worn leather journal and poured out the day's small joys and worries, watching my scattered thoughts settle into calm, orderly lines. （读后续写·写日记的习惯）
I would strongly recommend that every student keep a journal, for the simple act of writing down our feelings each day helps us understand ourselves and track our growth. （应用文·学习方法建议信）
According to a recent article in a respected medical journal, keeping a daily journal can significantly reduce stress and sharpen one's memory. （议论文·健康与习惯，兼含'期刊'与'日记'双义）
Years later, flipping through her childhood journal, she laughed and wept at the earnest, misspelled hopes of the girl she used to be. （读后续写·重读旧日记）

wordForms.noun: journal (日记/期刊) / journalism (新闻业) / journalist (记者)
wordForms.other: 构词：journal + -ist → journalist (记者)；journal + -ism → journalism (新闻业)。journaling / journalling (记日记的行为)。辨析 journal vs diary：diary 偏逐日私人生活记录，journal 兼指日记、札记与学术期刊。

collocations.example: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities. 我把自己的感受、想法和日常活动记成日记。（课件搭配）

collocations.translation: 【课件】期刊（作'期刊'义时多指严肃、专业或学术性刊物）
collocations.example: The paper appeared in an academic journal. 这篇论文发表在一份学术期刊上。（课件义'期刊'）

collocations.phrase: keep a journal of one's feelings, thoughts and daily activities
collocations.translation: 记录感受、想法和日常活动的日记（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities to see how much progress I was making. 我记下自己的感受、想法和日常活动，以观察自己取得了多大进步。（课文原句）
My teacher urged us to keep a journal in English. 老师督促我们用英语记日记。

collocations.translation: 科学 / 学术 / 医学期刊
collocations.example: Her research was published in a scientific journal. 她的研究发表在一份科学期刊上。
Unable to sleep, she wrote in her journal until dawn. 她睡不着，在日记里写到天亮。
He guarded his private journal fiercely. 他极力守护自己的私人日记。

collocations.phrase: a journal entry / an entry in a journal
collocations.example: The final journal entry ended abruptly in mid-sentence. 最后一则日记戛然而止，停在句子中间。
Her travel journal was crammed with sketches and ticket stubs. 她的旅行日记里塞满了速写和票根。
He had his first paper published in a national journal. 他的第一篇论文发表在了一份全国性期刊上。
The young naturalist kept a detailed journal of every bird and plant. 这位年轻的博物学家详细记录下每一种鸟和植物。

synonyms.example: She confided every secret to her diary, its little brass lock the only guardian of her hopes and fears. （读后续写·少女心事）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:diary 强调'按日期逐日记录个人生活起居'，偏私密、多写发生的事；journal 涵盖更广，可指日记，也可指有主题的札记、观察记录，甚至严肃学术期刊，且更侧重感受与反思。句法上二者均可搭配 keep a diary / keep a journal。

synonyms.example: The captain dutifully updated the ship's log, noting the coordinates, the weather and the dwindling supplies. （读后续写/记叙·航海记录）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:log 强调'系统、客观地记录数据、事件'，多用于航海、飞行、工作；journal 更侧重个人感受与思考的抒发。

synonyms.example: She flicked through a glossy fashion magazine while waiting for her turn at the salon. （应用文/记叙·日常场景）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:magazine 指面向大众的普通杂志（时尚、娱乐等）；journal 作'期刊'义时多指严肃、专业或学术性刊物。

advancedExpressions.expression: journal → journalist (记者) / journalism (新闻业) / journalistic (新闻的)
advancedExpressions.example: The journalist kept a personal journal alongside her professional journalism. 这位记者在从事新闻工作之余还记私人日记。（-ist 表人、-ism 表行业/主义）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「记录/刊物」(据义辨用)
advancedExpressions.expression: journal (日记/期刊) / diary (私人日记) / log (客观日志) / magazine (大众杂志)
advancedExpressions.example: She keeps a journal, he keeps a diary, the pilot keeps a log, and they all read the same magazine. 她记札记，他记日记，飞行员记航行日志，而他们都读同一本杂志。

advancedExpressions.expression: keep a journal / write in one's journal / a journal entry / publish in a journal
advancedExpressions.example: He wrote a long entry in his journal that night. 那晚他在日记里写下长长的一则。

advancedExpressions.expression: sb. poured ... into one's journal
advancedExpressions.example: That night she poured every unspoken fear into her journal, and as the words filled the page, the tightness in her chest gradually eased. （pour...into比喻情感宣泄 + and引出情绪释放的因果，写以笔疗心）

advancedExpressions.expression: keeping a journal is a habit worth cultivating, for ...
advancedExpressions.example: Keeping a journal is a habit well worth cultivating, for it not only preserves fleeting memories but also nurtures the ability to reflect. （动名词主语 + worth cultivating推荐 + not only...but also递进论证，倡议信实用句式）

advancedExpressions.expression: as research published in journals suggests, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As research published in leading psychology journals suggests, the habit of journaling can measurably lower anxiety and enhance emotional resilience. （as引导非限定 + published in journals借权威增强说服力，议论文引证句式）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I kept a journal to record my progress.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: I kept a journal of my feelings, thoughts and daily struggles, and turning back through its pages weeks later, I was astonished to see just how far, quietly and steadily, I had come. （读后续写·成长回顾）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: journal of三名词并列(feelings, thoughts, struggles) + 分词状语(turning back through...) + astonished情绪反应 + how far...I had come成长收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Writing a journal every day is helpful for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: It is my sincere conviction that the humble daily journal is one of the most powerful tools a student can wield, for through its honest pages we learn to observe, to reflect and, ultimately, to know ourselves. （应用文·建议信）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: It is my sincere conviction that...正式框架 + one of the most...最高级 + for引原因 + 三不定式递进(observe, reflect, know ourselves)升华

classPractice.question: 我坚持把自己的感受、想法和日常活动记成日记。I kept a ____ ____ my feelings, thoughts and daily activities.
classPractice.note: 课件搭配 keep a journal of sth '记……的日记'；journal 此处为'日记'义

classPractice.question: 写出 journal 在句中的含义（日记 / 期刊）：Her research was finally published in a leading scientific journal.
classPractice.answer: 期刊（scientific journal 科学期刊）
classPractice.note: 课件义；journal 作'期刊'时多指学术/专业刊物，区别于'日记'

classPractice.question: I kept a ____ of my feelings, thoughts and daily activities to see how much progress I was making.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；keep a journal '记日记'，journal 此处为'日记'义

classPractice.question: Her research was finally published in a leading scientific journal, thanks to the help of an experienced ____ (journal).
classPractice.note: journal + -ist → journalist（记者）；同句 journal 用作'期刊'义

classPractice.question: 用 journal / diary 填空：The pilot recorded the flight data in a technical ____, while the little girl wrote her secrets in a pink ____.
classPractice.note: journal 可指有主题的客观/学术记录；diary 偏私人逐日日记

original_sentence: The details of the scene were revealed in front of me: the soft sunlight, a bird singing from a high tree branch, the rich and earthy smell of the soil after the rain.
readingExamples: The details of the scene were revealed in front of me: the soft sunlight, a bird singing from a high tree branch, the rich and earthy smell of the soil after the rain.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to make known something that was previously secret or unknown
(2) vt. to allow something to be seen that was previously hidden or covered
(3) vt. (of a fact or situation) to show or demonstrate something clearly

uncommonMeanings.meaning: （尤指电视节目、活动中的）揭晓，亮相时刻
uncommonMeanings.example: The whole family gathered around the screen for the big reveal, and when the curtains finally dropped, a collective gasp filled the room. （读后续写·揭晓时刻，熟词僻义作名词'揭晓'）

posExamples.sentence: As the morning mist slowly lifted, the valley revealed itself in breathtaking splendour: golden terraces, a silver ribbon of river, and a lone farmhouse crowned with drifting smoke. （读后续写·晨雾散尽·壮景展现）
I am writing to reveal a hidden gem in our community — a small volunteer library that, though little known, has quietly transformed the lives of dozens of children. （应用文·推荐信）
A closer examination of history reveals that every great advance in civilisation was born not of comfort, but of hardship and relentless effort. （议论文·历史与奋斗）
When she finally opened the dusty box, it revealed a bundle of yellowed letters, each one a fragile window into a love story time had almost erased. （读后续写·揭开尘封往事）

wordForms.noun: revelation (揭示/启示) / reveal (揭晓时刻)
wordForms.adjective: revealing (暴露的/揭示性的) / revelatory (启示性的) / revealed
wordForms.other: 反义词 conceal (隐藏) / hide / cover up。构词：reveal → revelation (注意拼写变化 -eal→-elation)。词根 vel = 面纱(veil)，re-(去) + veal → 揭去面纱→揭示。

collocations.translation: 【课件】向某人揭示 / 透露某事（reveal: to make sth known to sb 揭示；透露；显示）
collocations.example: The doctor didn't reveal the truth to him. 医生没有把真相告诉他。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】揭示；显示（使原本看不见的显现出来）
collocations.example: A gap in the clouds revealed the Atlantic far below. 从云缝中可以看到远在下方的大西洋。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: It is revealed that + 从句
collocations.translation: 【课件】据透露 / 据揭示……（形式主语 it）
collocations.example: It is revealed that the company made a huge loss last year. 据透露，该公司去年蒙受了巨额亏损。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: the details ... were revealed in front of sb
collocations.translation: ……的细节在某人面前一一显现（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: The details of the scene were revealed in front of me: the soft sunlight, a bird singing from a high tree branch, the rich and earthy smell of the soil after the rain. 眼前的景致一一显现：柔和的阳光、高枝上鸣唱的鸟、雨后泥土浓郁的芬芳。（课文原句）
The survey revealed that many students sacrifice sleep for phones. 调查显示许多学生为玩手机而牺牲睡眠。

collocations.translation: 在……面前显现 / 向某人揭示
collocations.example: The full beauty of the scene was revealed to me. 那景致的全部之美向我展现出来。
He finally revealed the secret he had kept for years. 他终于说出了藏了多年的秘密。
The investigation revealed the truth at last. 调查最终揭示了真相。
As the fog thinned, the castle revealed itself. 雾一散，城堡便显现出来。
Recent studies reveal that gratitude improves well-being. 近期研究表明感恩能提升幸福感。

collocations.translation: 流露真情 / 显露真我
collocations.example: Only then did his face soften, revealing his true feelings. 直到那时他脸色才柔和下来，流露出真情。
The show revealed her hidden talent for singing. 这次演出展露出她隐藏的歌唱天赋。

synonyms.example: The company finally disclosed the figures, and the board fell into a stunned, uneasy silence. （应用文/记叙·正式披露）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:disclose 更正式、更书面，多用于官方公开信息、数据、财务等，常接 that 从句或名词；reveal 用法更广，可指抽象揭示，也可指景物、情感的显露。

synonyms.example: The brave journalist exposed the scandal, refusing to be silenced by threats or bribes. （议论文/记叙·揭露黑幕）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:expose 常含'揭露丑闻、罪行、真相中不光彩的一面'的负面色彩，也可指'使暴露于（危险/日光）'；reveal 中性，可褒可贬，情感范围更广。

synonyms.example: At the ceremony, the mayor unveiled the statue to a burst of applause and fluttering cameras. （应用文/记叙·揭幕仪式）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:unveil 字面'揭去面纱'，多用于正式场合首次公开雕像、产品、计划等；reveal 更日常、更通用，不限于'首次'。

synonyms.example: While clearing the attic, they uncovered a trunk of wartime letters that rewrote the family's history. （读后续写·意外发现）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:uncover 强调'通过挖掘、清理而发现原本被掩盖之物'，动作性强；reveal 更侧重'使显现、使知晓'的结果。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·reveal 词族与反义
advancedExpressions.expression: reveal → revelation (n. 揭示/启示) / revealing (adj. 暴露的)；反义 conceal (隐藏)
advancedExpressions.example: What she chose to reveal, and what she chose to conceal, told two different stories. 她选择揭示的与选择隐藏的，讲述了两个不同的故事。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「揭示/公开」(据语气辨用)
advancedExpressions.expression: reveal (中性) / disclose (正式公开) / expose (揭露丑恶) / unveil (首次揭幕) / uncover (挖掘发现)
advancedExpressions.example: The report revealed the facts, disclosed the figures and exposed the fraud. 报告揭示了事实、公开了数据、揭露了骗局。

advancedExpressions.expression: reveal that + 从句 / reveal itself / be revealed to sb / studies reveal
advancedExpressions.example: Studies reveal that sleep affects memory. 研究表明睡眠影响记忆。（reveal 后接 that 从句，主语常为 study/survey/research）

advancedExpressions.expression: as ..., ... revealed itself in ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the last of the mist melted away, the mountain revealed itself in all its snow-capped majesty, and we stood in awed, wordless wonder. （as时间状语 + reveal itself拟人 + in all its...majesty夸张 + 群体反应收束，写壮景乍现）

advancedExpressions.expression: allow me to reveal ...
advancedExpressions.example: Allow me to reveal a small but remarkable corner of our school that most of us walk past unnoticed — the rooftop garden tended entirely by student volunteers. （allow me to reveal礼貌引出 + but转折制造反差，推荐信吸引注意的开篇技法）

advancedExpressions.expression: a closer look reveals that ...
advancedExpressions.example: A closer look at these success stories reveals that talent alone rarely accounts for achievement; it is discipline and perseverance that make the crucial difference. （a closer look reveals that客观引出 + it is...that强调，议论文层层揭示论点）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I saw the beautiful scene clearly.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The details of the scene were revealed one by one before my eyes: the soft, slanting sunlight, a bird trilling from a high branch, and the rich, earthy fragrance of the soil rising after the rain. （读后续写·感官白描）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 被动 were revealed + one by one渐次展开 + 冒号列举三重感官(视觉/听觉/嗅觉) + 形容词叠用(soft, slanting; rich, earthy)增强画面

sentenceUpgrade.original: Hard work is the reason for success.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: A careful study of history reveals a truth too often overlooked: that behind every dazzling triumph lies not luck, but countless hours of unseen, unglamorous toil. （议论文·奋斗主题）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: A careful study...reveals客观论证 + 冒号引出核心观点 + behind...lies倒装 + not...but对照(luck vs toil)，强化'努力决定成功'的论点

classPractice.question: 医生没有把真相告诉他。The doctor didn't ____ the truth ____ him.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；reveal sth to sb '向某人揭示/透露某事'

classPractice.question: 据透露，该公司去年蒙受了巨额亏损。____ ____ ____ that the company made a huge loss last year.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；It is revealed that... '据透露/据揭示……'，it 为形式主语

classPractice.question: The details of the scene were ____ (reveal) in front of me: the soft sunlight, a bird singing, the smell of the soil after the rain.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；被动语态 be revealed '被显现'；details 为复数主语用 were

classPractice.question: 用 reveal / conceal 填空：Instead of trying to ____ his mistake, the honest boy chose to ____ the whole truth to his parents.
classPractice.note: reveal 与反义词 conceal 对举；conceal 隐藏，reveal 揭示

classPractice.question: 这项调查揭示出许多学生每晚为玩手机而牺牲睡眠。The survey ____ ____ many students sacrifice sleep for their phones every night.
classPractice.note: reveal that + 从句，主语为 survey/study/research 时的高考高频句式

original_sentence: Best of all, I began to appreciate the beauty in life with my own eyes, instead of through my smartphone camera.
readingExamples: Best of all, I began to appreciate the beauty in life with my own eyes, instead of through my smartphone camera.
definitionEn:
(1) vt. to recognize the good qualities of someone or something and enjoy or value them
(2) vt. to be grateful for something that someone has done
(3) vt. to understand fully how serious or important a situation is
(4) vi. (of property, currency, etc.) to increase in value over a period of time

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】① 欣赏，赏识（认识到……的优点并喜爱、珍视）
uncommonMeanings.example: You can't really appreciate foreign literature in translation. 读译本你无法真正欣赏外国文学。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】② 感激，感谢（appreciate it if... / appreciate (sb) doing sth）
uncommonMeanings.example: I would appreciate it if you paid in cash. 若你用现金支付，我将不胜感激。/ We would appreciate you informing us of any problems. 如蒙告知任何问题，我们将不胜感激。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 【课件】③ 理解，领会（充分认识到……的意义/处境）
uncommonMeanings.example: It is hard for people to appreciate what we have gone through. 人们很难理解我们所经历的一切。（课件原句）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 欣赏，赏识（认识到……的优点并喜爱、珍视）——课文义
uncommonMeanings.example: I began to appreciate the beauty in life with my own eyes. 我开始用自己的双眼去欣赏生活之美。（课文义）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 感谢，感激（对某人所做之事心存感激）
uncommonMeanings.example: I'd appreciate it if you could reply soon. 若你能尽快回复，我将不胜感激。

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 充分意识到，深刻理解（形势的严重性/重要性）
uncommonMeanings.example: Only after the storm swept away half the harvest did the villagers truly appreciate how fragile their comfortable lives had always been. （读后续写·灾难·顿悟）

uncommonMeanings.meaning: 增值，升值（金融/财产，反义 depreciate 贬值）
uncommonMeanings.example: Grandfather always said the little cottage by the sea would appreciate in value, and years later, when the coast became a tourist hotspot, his quiet foresight left the whole family speechless. （读后续写·家族传承·远见）

posExamples.sentence: Standing at the mountaintop as dawn spilled gold across the valley, I finally learned to appreciate the beauty that had surrounded me all along, unnoticed behind the glow of my phone screen. （读后续写·自然顿悟）
I am writing to express how deeply I appreciate the tireless guidance you offered throughout the debate season, without which our team could never have reached the national final. （应用文·感谢信）
Students who take a gap year often come back with a heightened ability to appreciate the value of formal education, precisely because they have experienced life beyond the classroom. （议论文·教育话题）
We would greatly appreciate it if all residents could sort their household waste before the collection truck arrives each morning. （应用文·通知）

wordForms.adjective: appreciative (感激的/赏识的) / appreciable (可观的/明显的)
wordForms.other: 反义 depreciate (贬值) / underestimate (低估)。辨析 appreciable(可觉察的、相当大的) vs appreciative(心怀感激的)——形近义异，勿混。名词 in appreciation of '为感激……'。

collocations.phrase: appreciate foreign literature（欣赏外国文学）
collocations.translation: 【课件】欣赏，赏识（认识到优点并喜爱、珍视）
collocations.example: You can't really appreciate foreign literature in translation. 读译本你无法真正欣赏外国文学。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】如果……我将不胜感激（it 作形式宾语，不可省）
collocations.example: I would appreciate it if you paid in cash. 若你用现金支付，我将不胜感激。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】感激（某人）做某事（后接动名词，不接不定式）
collocations.example: We would appreciate you informing us of any problems. 如蒙告知任何问题，我们将不胜感激。（课件原句）
It is hard for people to appreciate what we have gone through. 人们很难理解我们所经历的一切。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】对……的欣赏（力）/ 理解（appreciation n. 欣赏 / 感激 / 理解）
collocations.example: Children should develop an appreciation of poetry. 应培养孩子对诗歌的欣赏力。/ I had no appreciation of the problems they faced. 我当时没能理解他们所面对的难题。（课件原句）

collocations.translation: 【课件】为感激……，以表达对……的谢意
collocations.example: Please accept this gift in appreciation of/for all you've done for us. 请收下这份礼物，以感谢你为我们所做的一切。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: a great appreciation for life beyond the screen
collocations.translation: 【课件】对屏幕之外的生活的深深欣赏（享受）
collocations.example: It gave me a great appreciation for life beyond the screen. 它让我好好欣赏（享受）屏幕之外的生活。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: appreciate the beauty in life with one's own eyes
collocations.translation: 用自己的双眼欣赏生活之美（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Best of all, I began to appreciate the beauty in life with my own eyes, instead of through my smartphone camera. 最棒的是，我开始用自己的双眼、而不是透过手机镜头去欣赏生活之美。（课文原句）

collocations.translation: 如果……我将不胜感激（客套请求，it 不可省）
collocations.example: I'd appreciate it if you could send me the schedule. 如果你能把日程发给我，我将不胜感激。

collocations.translation: 感激/乐于做某事（后接动名词，不接不定式）
collocations.example: I really appreciate your helping me with this. 我很感激你帮我做这件事。
She slowed down to appreciate the beauty of the ordinary. 她放慢脚步去欣赏平凡之美。
Living abroad, I now truly appreciate home. 身在异乡，我如今才真正体会到家的可贵。

collocations.phrase: appreciate the value / importance of sth
collocations.example: They came to appreciate the importance of teamwork. 他们逐渐认识到团队合作的重要性。
I deeply appreciate your support. 我深深感激你的支持。

collocations.translation: 感激某人的努力／善意／支持
collocations.example: She appreciated his quiet support more than any words. 她感激他默默的支持胜过一切言语。
Only by leaving home can we learn to appreciate it. 只有离开家，我们才学会珍惜它。
Fine art tends to appreciate in value over time. 艺术品往往随时间增值。

synonyms.example: He valued the old watch not for its price but for the memories it carried of his late father. （读后续写·遗物）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:value 侧重主观上认为某物重要而珍惜，句法为 value sth；appreciate 更强调'因看到其优点而欣赏'，或表'感激'，可接名词、动名词或 it if 从句。

synonyms.example: She cherished every letter he wrote, tying them with a faded ribbon and reading them on lonely nights. （读后续写·思念）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:cherish 情感色彩最浓，多用于珍爱人或有情感意义之物；appreciate 更中性，可用于抽象价值、审美欣赏与感激。

synonyms.example: I shall always treasure the friendships forged during those unforgettable exchange days abroad. （应用文·告别信）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:treasure 语气强烈，强调把某物当作宝贝般珍藏；appreciate 侧重欣赏与感激，程度较轻。

synonyms.example: The judges acknowledged the young inventor's ingenuity even though his device failed on stage. （议论文·创新）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:acknowledge 侧重公开承认某人的贡献或事实；appreciate 含有内心欣赏与感激之意，语气更暖。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·appreciate 的句法(高考高频)
advancedExpressions.expression: appreciate + 名词/动名词/one's doing；I'd appreciate it if + 从句（it 不可省）
advancedExpressions.example: I'd appreciate it if you could turn down the music. 如果你能把音乐调小些，我将不胜感激。（appreciate 后不接不定式，接从句时须用 it 作形式宾语）

advancedExpressions.expression: appreciate → appreciation (n.) / appreciative (adj. 感激的) / appreciable (adj. 可观的)；反义 depreciate
advancedExpressions.example: In appreciation of their help, she wrote each an appreciative note. 为感激他们的帮助，她给每人写了一张感谢便条。

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「珍视/欣赏」(据语气辨用)
advancedExpressions.expression: appreciate (欣赏/感激) / value (重视) / cherish (珍爱) / treasure (珍藏)
advancedExpressions.example: We should appreciate, value and cherish the time we spend together. 我们应欣赏、重视并珍惜共处的时光。

advancedExpressions.expression: it was not until ... that sb. came to appreciate ...
advancedExpressions.example: It was not until the noise of the city fell silent behind her that she came to appreciate just how much she had taken the quiet of home for granted. （not until 强调句 + 心理转折，续写升华段）

advancedExpressions.expression: words can hardly express how much I appreciate ...
advancedExpressions.example: Words can hardly express how much I appreciate the countless hours you devoted to guiding a clumsy beginner like me. （夸张修辞开头，感谢信情感铺垫）

advancedExpressions.expression: to truly appreciate ..., one must first ...
advancedExpressions.example: To truly appreciate the freedom we enjoy today, one must first understand the sacrifices made by those who came before us. （条件递进句式，引出论证前提）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I began to appreciate the beauty of life.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Slowly, as the frantic buzzing of notifications faded from my mind, I began to appreciate the quiet beauty of life unfolding right before my eyes — the crimson dusk, the laughter of strangers, the ordinary miracles I had scrolled past for years. （读后续写·顿悟+排比）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 副词开头控制节奏(Slowly) + as 时间状语从句 + 破折号引出排比意象(dusk, laughter, miracles) + 对比(scrolled past)

sentenceUpgrade.techniques: take this opportunity to 正式套语 + heartfelt appreciation 名词化升级 + selfless help 形容词修饰 + during 时间状语点明背景

classPractice.note: I'd appreciate it if... 固定句式，it 作形式宾语，指代后面 if 从句，不可省略
