classPractice.note: appreciative(adj.感激的)修饰 smile；appreciation(n.感激)作主语，考词族与词性

translation: 覆盖面广的，内容广泛的
original_sentence: Our wide-ranging conversation went so much deeper than brief texts ever could.
readingExamples: Our wide-ranging conversation went so much deeper than brief texts ever could.
definitionEn:
(1) adj. including or dealing with a great variety of different subjects, activities, or areas
(2) adj. covering or affecting a large area or a great extent
(3) adj. (of effects, consequences, powers) far-reaching and extensive in scope

posExamples.sentence: As the fire crackled between us that night, our wide-ranging conversation drifted from childhood dreams to distant galaxies, and I realized we had talked until the stars began to fade. （读后续写·深夜长谈）
Our club offers a wide-ranging programme of activities, from calligraphy and debate to astronomy and volunteering, so that every new member can find a passion of their own. （应用文·招新启事）
The wide-ranging benefits of reading — sharpened thinking, broadened horizons, and deepened empathy — make it far more than a mere pastime. （议论文·阅读价值）
The new policy is expected to have wide-ranging consequences for how students balance study and rest in the coming years. （议论文·政策影响）

wordForms.other: 合成词：wide (adv./adj. 广) + ranging (range 的现在分词) → wide-ranging '范围广的'。同构复合形容词：far-reaching(影响深远的)、hard-working(勤奋的)、good-looking(好看的)、time-consuming(耗时的)。作定语，前加连字符。

collocations.phrase: our wide-ranging conversation went deeper than ...
collocations.translation: 我们内容广泛的交谈比……更深入（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: Our wide-ranging conversation went so much deeper than brief texts ever could. 我们内容广泛的交谈远比简短的短信深入得多。（课文原句）
We fell into a wide-ranging discussion over dinner. 晚餐时我们聊起了一场内容广泛的讨论。
Climate change has wide-ranging effects. 气候变化有广泛的影响。
A wide-ranging survey revealed students crave hands-on learning. 一项覆盖面广的调查显示学生渴望动手学习。
A boy of wide-ranging interests, he loved both football and philosophy. 他兴趣广泛，既爱足球也爱哲学。
Her wide-ranging experience abroad made her sensitive to cultural differences. 她广博的海外经历使她对文化差异很敏感。
The concert won wide-ranging support across the community. 这场音乐会赢得了整个社区的广泛支持。
The government announced wide-ranging measures to ease students' burden. 政府宣布了一系列范围广泛的减负措施。

synonyms.example: His extensive reading over the years lent his essays an unusual depth and range. （议论文·积累）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:extensive 侧重数量大、范围宽，常修饰研究、损害、知识；wide-ranging 更强调涵盖话题／领域的多样性，多修饰 conversation/effects。

synonyms.example: One small act of kindness can have far-reaching effects on a stranger's entire day. （读后续写·善意）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:far-reaching 侧重影响、后果延伸得又广又深，多修饰 effects/consequences；wide-ranging 侧重内容或范围的广博。

synonyms.example: The teacher handed out a comprehensive guide covering every stage of the writing process. （应用文·指南）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:comprehensive 强调面面俱到、无遗漏；wide-ranging 侧重跨越多个不同领域，不必然要求完整。

synonyms.example: The festival celebrated the diverse traditions that make our community so vibrant. （应用文·文化活动）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:diverse 强调种类繁多且彼此不同；wide-ranging 更侧重覆盖的广度而非差异性本身。

advancedExpressions.type: 构词法·wide-ranging 属「副词/形容词 + 现在分词」复合形容词
advancedExpressions.expression: wide-ranging / far-reaching / hard-working / long-lasting / record-breaking
advancedExpressions.example: It was a wide-ranging, far-reaching and long-lasting reform. 这是一场内容广泛、影响深远而持久的改革。（此类合成形容词常作定语，横线连接）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「广泛的」(据搭配辨用)
advancedExpressions.expression: wide-ranging (话题多样) / extensive (数量大) / comprehensive (全面无遗漏) / far-reaching (影响深远)
advancedExpressions.example: The plan is wide-ranging in scope and far-reaching in impact. 该计划范围广泛、影响深远。

advancedExpressions.expression: our wide-ranging talk drifted from ... to ...
advancedExpressions.example: Our wide-ranging talk drifted from forgotten summers to unspoken fears, until the boundaries between two strangers quietly dissolved. （drift from...to... 意象流动 + 情感递进，续写长谈场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: with its wide-ranging ..., sth. offers something for everyone
advancedExpressions.example: With its wide-ranging selection of courses, our summer camp offers something for every curious mind. （介词短语前置 + 广度卖点，招募推介）

advancedExpressions.expression: the wide-ranging benefits of ... extend far beyond ...
advancedExpressions.example: The wide-ranging benefits of physical exercise extend far beyond a healthy body, reaching into our mood, focus and resilience. （extend beyond 拓展论点，凸显广度）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We talked about many different things.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Our wide-ranging conversation wandered freely from the books that had shaped us to the fears we had never dared to voice, going so much deeper than any brief text ever could. （读后续写·长谈）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: wide-ranging 精准替换 many different + wander freely 拟人化动词 + from...to... 意象对照 + go deeper than 比较升华

sentenceUpgrade.original: The activity has many benefits.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: The wide-ranging benefits of such an activity — from fostering teamwork to nurturing lifelong friendships — make it an experience no student should miss. （议论文/推介）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: wide-ranging 提升正式度 + 破折号插入具体举例(from...to...) + make it 结论句强调 + no student should 增强号召力

classPractice.question: Our ____ (wide / range) conversation went so much deeper than brief texts ever could.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；wide + ranging 合成形容词作定语，用连字符连接

classPractice.question: 用 wide-ranging / comprehensive 填空：The new club offers a ____ programme of activities, from calligraphy to astronomy.
classPractice.note: wide-ranging 强调话题/领域多样；此处 from...to... 正凸显广度

classPractice.question: 这项新政策预计将产生广泛的影响。The new policy is expected to have ____ ____.
classPractice.answer: wide-ranging consequences / wide-ranging effects / wide-ranging impact
classPractice.note: wide-ranging 常搭配 effects/consequences/impact 表'广泛的影响'

original_sentence: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
readingExamples: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a dramatic musical work in which the words are sung to orchestral accompaniment
(2) n. operas considered as an art form or genre
(3) n. a building or company where operas are performed

posExamples.sentence: As the soprano's final note soared through the grand hall, Grandpa gripped my hand tightly, and I saw a tear glisten in the eye of a man who had never once shown weakness — the opera had reached a place words never could. （读后续写·祖孙情）
I am writing to warmly invite you to a Chinese opera evening our club will host next Friday, where students will perform classic scenes and share the rich history behind each melody. （应用文·邀请信）
Some dismiss opera as an outdated art form, yet its power to convey raw human emotion through music alone makes it as relevant today as it was centuries ago. （议论文·传统艺术）
We spent that unforgettable week together: we went to the opera, played badminton in the park, and lost ourselves for hours in the quiet halls of the city museum. （读后续写·相聚时光）

collocations.translation: 去看歌剧（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums. 我们去看歌剧、打羽毛球、参观博物馆。（课文原句）
She never misses her favourite soap opera. 她从不错过自己最爱的肥皂剧。
The exchange students loved the masks of Peking opera. 交换生们很喜欢京剧的脸谱。
The old opera house had a gilded ceiling. 那座老歌剧院有镀金的天花板。
Her dream was to become an opera singer. 她的梦想是成为一名歌剧演唱家。
The students staged a shortened opera. 学生们上演了一出缩短版的歌剧。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·opera 常用搭配（含义辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: go to the opera (看歌剧) / a soap opera (肥皂剧) / an opera house (歌剧院) / an opera singer (歌剧演唱家)
advancedExpressions.example: After watching a soap opera all afternoon, she went to the opera in the evening. 她下午看了一下午肥皂剧，晚上又去看了歌剧。（soap opera 指电视连续剧，opera 指歌剧，勿混）

advancedExpressions.expression: opera (n.) → operatic (adj. 歌剧的) / operatically (adv.)
advancedExpressions.example: Her voice had an operatic power. 她的嗓音有歌剧般的力量。

advancedExpressions.type: 读后续写·环境/情感烘托
advancedExpressions.expression: as the music of the opera swelled, ...
advancedExpressions.example: As the music of the opera swelled to its climax, the whole audience seemed to hold its breath as one. （as 从句 + swell 动态动词 + 群体反应烘托，续写高潮场景）

advancedExpressions.expression: an evening of opera that celebrates ...
advancedExpressions.example: Join us for an evening of opera that celebrates the timeless beauty of our cultural heritage. （祈使句号召 + that 定语从句点明意义，邀请/海报）

advancedExpressions.expression: far from being outdated, opera remains ...
advancedExpressions.example: Far from being outdated, opera remains a living bridge between the emotions of the past and the audiences of today. （Far from 让步开头 + bridge 隐喻，传统艺术论证）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We went to the opera and enjoyed it.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That evening we went to the opera, and as the final aria faded into a hush, we sat motionless in the dark, unwilling to break the spell the music had woven around us. （读后续写·沉浸）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: as 时间从句叠加 + fade into a hush 通感 + sit motionless 动作静默 + weave a spell 隐喻收束

sentenceUpgrade.original: Opera is an old art but still good.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Though opera is often labelled an art of the past, it endures precisely because it speaks to emotions that no era can outgrow. （议论文·传统艺术）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Though 让步状语从句 + be labelled 被动委婉 + precisely because 因果强调 + no era can outgrow 抽象升华

classPractice.question: 那天我们去看歌剧、打羽毛球、参观博物馆。That day we went to the ____, played badminton, and visited museums.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；go to the opera '去看歌剧'为固定搭配

classPractice.question: 用 opera / soap opera 填空：My grandpa loves classical ____ at the theatre, while my mum prefers a daily TV ____.
classPractice.note: opera 指歌剧（剧场艺术）；soap opera 指电视肥皂剧/连续剧

original_sentence: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
readingExamples: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums.
definitionEn:
(1) n. a game played by two or four people who use light rackets to hit a shuttlecock over a net
(2) n. the sport of badminton as a recreational or competitive activity

posExamples.sentence: In the golden light of the late afternoon, we played badminton until the shuttlecock became a mere shadow against the darkening sky, our laughter echoing across the empty court. （读后续写·青春时光）
To promote a healthier campus, our sports club warmly invites all students to join the friendly badminton tournament to be held this Saturday afternoon in the school gym. （应用文·活动通知）
Team sports such as badminton teach young people far more than physical fitness; they cultivate cooperation, resilience and the grace to accept defeat. （议论文·体育教育）

collocations.translation: 打羽毛球（课文原句词块；不可数，不加 a/the，不加 -s）
collocations.example: We went to the opera, played badminton, and visited museums. 我们去看歌剧、打羽毛球、参观博物馆。（课文原句）
The new badminton court is always busy. 新的羽毛球场总是很热闹。
He gripped the badminton racket tightly. 他紧紧握住羽毛球拍。
The inter-class badminton tournament drew a big crowd. 班际羽毛球锦标赛吸引了众多观众。
A quick game of badminton melted away the stress. 一场轻快的羽毛球赛驱散了压力。

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·球类/棋类运动前不加冠词
advancedExpressions.expression: play badminton / play basketball / play chess（球类、棋类前零冠词；乐器前加 the）
advancedExpressions.example: We play badminton after class, then play the piano at home. 我们课后打羽毛球，回家弹钢琴。（运动名词前不加冠词，乐器前加 the，对比记忆）

advancedExpressions.expression: play badminton / a badminton court / racket / match / tournament
advancedExpressions.example: They booked a badminton court for the weekend match. 他们为周末的比赛订了一个羽毛球场。

advancedExpressions.expression: the shuttlecock arced back and forth as ...
advancedExpressions.example: The shuttlecock arced back and forth against the sunset sky, and for a while the whole world shrank to that small white blur and the sound of our laughter. （arc 动态动词 + 世界缩小到细节，续写沉浸画面）

advancedExpressions.expression: we cordially invite you to take part in a badminton ...
advancedExpressions.example: We cordially invite you to take part in a badminton tournament designed to bring more energy and friendship to campus life. （cordially invite 正式套语 + designed to 目的状语，通知/邀请）

advancedExpressions.expression: a sport like badminton does more than ...; it ...
advancedExpressions.example: A sport like badminton does more than strengthen the body; it teaches us to stay composed when the score is against us. （does more than 递进否定 + 分号并列，凸显体育的教育意义）

sentenceUpgrade.original: We played badminton in the afternoon.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: All afternoon we chased the shuttlecock across the court, our shirts damp with sweat and our faces bright with a joy that no screen had ever given us. （读后续写·青春）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: chase the shuttlecock 具象动作 + across the court 空间感 + 独立主格(shirts damp, faces bright) + no screen had given 对比主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: Playing badminton is good for students.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: Regularly playing badminton offers students not only a fitter body but also a sharper mind and a stronger sense of teamwork. （议论文·体育价值）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: Regularly 副词强调习惯 + not only...but also 递进结构 + 三重益处并列(body, mind, teamwork)

classPractice.question: We went to the opera, ____ (play) badminton, and visited museums.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；与 went、visited 并列，用一般过去时；badminton 前不加冠词

classPractice.question: 每个周末这两个朋友都会在公园打羽毛球。Every weekend the two friends ____ ____ in the park.
classPractice.note: play badminton 固定搭配，运动名词前零冠词、不可数不加 -s

original_sentence: I cannot escape from the modern world, but I can cut back on the amount of time I spend on my smartphone every day, and I do.
readingExamples: I cannot escape from the modern world, but I can cut back on the amount of time I spend on my smartphone every day, and I do.
definitionEn:
(1) phr. v. to reduce the amount, size, or extent of something, especially spending, consumption, or an activity
(2) phr. v. to do less of something or use less of something in order to save resources or improve one's situation

posExamples.sentence: After that quiet evening by the lake, I resolved to cut back on the hours I lost to my phone, and slowly the world around me — birdsong, sunlight, the faces of friends — came sharply back into focus. （读后续写·自我改变）
To protect our environment, I sincerely urge every classmate to cut back on the use of disposable plastics and carry a reusable bottle instead. （应用文·倡议书）
If teenagers were encouraged to cut back on screen time, they would likely discover more meaningful ways to spend the precious hours of their youth. （议论文·青少年与科技）
The company decided to cut back on unnecessary expenses in order to survive the difficult year ahead. （应用文·报告）

idioms.idiom: cut back on = cut down on
idioms.translation: 减少，削减（数量/频率/消费，二者可互换）
idioms.example: To lose weight, he cut back on / cut down on fast food. 为了减肥，他减少了吃快餐。（cut back on 略偏正式，常用于开支、资源、时间）

collocations.phrase: cut back on = cut sth back / cut down on sth
collocations.translation: 【课件】减少；削减（数量、规模、开支等）= cut sth back；近义短语 cut down on sth
collocations.example: Several major hospitals are cutting back on staff at the moment. 现在有几家大医院正在裁员。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: cut back on sth（少吃，少喝）
collocations.translation: 【课件】少吃，少喝（尤指为了健康而减少食用/饮用某物）
collocations.example: Try to cut back on foods containing wheat and dairy products. 要少吃含小麦和奶制品的食物。（课件原句）

collocations.phrase: cut back on a rose bush
collocations.example: In autumn we cut back on the rose bush. 秋天我们给玫瑰丛剪枝。（课件义'修剪'）

collocations.phrase: cut back on the amount of time (one) spends on sth
collocations.translation: 减少花在某事上的时间量（课文原句词块）
collocations.example: I cannot escape from the modern world, but I can cut back on the amount of time I spend on my smartphone every day, and I do. 我无法逃离现代世界，但我可以减少每天花在手机上的时间——我确实这么做了。（课文原句）
Doctors advise us to cut back on screen time before bed. 医生建议我们睡前减少看屏幕的时间。
The family had to cut back on spending. 这家人不得不削减开支。

collocations.phrase: cut back on sugar / salt / meat
collocations.example: She began to cut back on sugar to stay healthy. 为了健康，她开始少吃糖。

collocations.phrase: cut back on the use of sth
collocations.example: Our school urged everyone to cut back on the use of paper. 学校号召大家减少用纸。
Cutting back on plastic bags makes a real difference. 减少塑料袋的使用会带来真正的改变。
The doctor advised him to cut back on his working hours. 医生建议他减少工作时间。
Our community significantly cut back on carbon emissions. 我们社区大幅削减了碳排放。

synonyms.example: He tried to cut down on late-night snacks to keep himself in shape for the season. （读后续写·自律）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:与 cut back on 几乎同义、可互换，都指减少某习惯／消费；cut back on 略偏正式，常用于开支、资源、时间，二者后均接名词/动名词。

synonyms.example: Planting more trees along the roads can noticeably reduce air pollution in the city. （议论文·环境）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:reduce 最正式、最通用的单个动词，直接跟宾语(reduce sth)；cut back on 更口语化，强调从原有水平上削减。

synonyms.example: The new rules aim to curb the excessive use of smartphones among primary school pupils. （议论文·管控）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:curb 侧重控制、遏制某种增长或不良趋势，语气较强、较正式；cut back on 侧重自身主动减少。

synonyms.example: In hard times the family learned to economize on every drop of water and every grain of rice. （读后续写·节俭）
synonyms.usage: 中文辨析:economize on 专指为省钱／省资源而节约，用法较书面；cut back on 适用范围更广，不限于节省资源。

advancedExpressions.type: 短语群·cut + 副词/介词（易混辨析）
advancedExpressions.expression: cut back on (削减) / cut down on (减少) / cut down (砍倒/削减) / cut off (切断) / cut in (插话/插队) / cut out (删去/戒掉)
advancedExpressions.example: He cut back on sugar, cut out fried food, and cut off all late-night snacks. 他减少糖分、戒掉油炸食品、断了所有夜宵。（同一动词配不同介副词，义项各异，成组记忆）

advancedExpressions.type: 同义表达群·「减少/削减」(可替换cut back on)
advancedExpressions.expression: cut back on ≈ cut down on / reduce / curb / economize on
advancedExpressions.example: We must cut back on / cut down on / reduce our use of plastic. 我们必须减少塑料的使用。（三者可替换，reduce 后直接接宾语，无 on）

advancedExpressions.type: 语法点·cut back on 后接名词或动名词
advancedExpressions.expression: cut back on + n. / doing sth（on 后不可接不定式）
advancedExpressions.example: She decided to cut back on eating out. 她决定减少下馆子的次数。（on 是介词，后接动名词 eating，不可用 to eat）

advancedExpressions.expression: from that day on, I resolved to cut back on ...
advancedExpressions.example: From that day on, I resolved to cut back on the endless scrolling that had quietly stolen my evenings, and to give that time back to the people I loved. （from that day on 时间标志 + resolved to 决心 + give back to 情感落点，续写转变段）

advancedExpressions.expression: let us start by cutting back on ...
advancedExpressions.example: Let us start by cutting back on the plastic we use each day, for every small step brings us closer to a greener campus. （Let us 号召句 + for 引出理由，倡议书行动呼吁）

advancedExpressions.expression: one effective solution is to cut back on ...
advancedExpressions.example: One effective solution to this growing problem is to cut back on our reliance on digital devices and rediscover the value of face-to-face connection. （one solution is to 提出对策 + rediscover 正向替代，议论文对策段）

sentenceUpgrade.original: I decided to use my phone less.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: That night, staring at the hours the screen had swallowed, I made a quiet vow to cut back on my phone use and reclaim the fragments of life I had let slip away unnoticed. （读后续写·决心）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: 分词状语(staring at...) + swallow 拟物化 + make a vow 正式化 + reclaim / slip away 对比动词升华主题

sentenceUpgrade.original: We should use less plastic to protect nature.
sentenceUpgrade.upgraded: If each of us is willing to cut back on plastic, however slightly, our combined efforts will grow into a powerful force for protecting the fragile world we share. （应用文·倡议）
sentenceUpgrade.techniques: If 条件句号召 + however slightly 让步插入 + combined efforts 集体力量 + grow into 隐喻 + fragile world 情感修饰

classPractice.question: 把 Several major hospitals are reducing their staff at the moment. 改为含 cut 短语的同义句：Several major hospitals are ____ ____ ____ staff at the moment.
classPractice.note: 课件原句；cut back on = reduce '减少/削减'，此处指裁员

classPractice.question: 写出 cut back on 在句中的含义（削减开支 / 少吃少喝 / 修剪）：Try to cut back on foods containing wheat and dairy products.
classPractice.answer: 少吃（尤指为健康而减少食用某物）
classPractice.note: 课件原句；此处 cut back on 表'少吃、少喝'

classPractice.question: I cannot escape from the modern world, but I can cut back on the amount of time I spend ____ my smartphone every day.
classPractice.note: 课文原句；spend time on sth '在……上花时间'，介词用 on

classPractice.question: 把 We should reduce our use of plastic. 改为含 cut 短语的同义句：We should ____ ____ ____ our use of plastic.
classPractice.answer: cut back on / cut down on
classPractice.note: cut back on = cut down on = reduce，均表'减少'；注意 reduce 后无 on

classPractice.question: 为了健康，她决定少吃糖，多吃蔬菜。To stay healthy, she decided to ____ ____ ____ sugar and eat more vegetables.
classPractice.answer: cut back on / cut down on
classPractice.note: cut back on + 名词 sugar；表'减少（摄入）'
